mi'i nywa sha rnams btang ngo*/ /rjes gzhan dang mthun no/ /gsum pa dpa' bo bdud rtsi 'chi med kyi sbyor ba ni/ btsan dug sran ma 'bring po tsam gnyis byis pa'i chu la sbyangs la/ rgya tshwa/ ldum bu re ral/ a ru ra zho bzhi/ shug pa tsher ma can gyi lo ma nyis 'gyur btang*/ de rnams zhib par btags la ri lu sran ma 'bring po tsam grib ma la bskams la/ mi dar ma la bdun/ rgan pa la lnga/ byis pa la gsum/ rgan drags pa dang*/ gzhon drags pa dang*/ tshad ro can la mi gtang ngo*/ /sman pa'i lag nyams kyis btsal ba ni/ mdzub mo'i 'og na sran ma lta bu sra la 'dril ba dang*/ tsher ma zug pa la mnan pa ltar na ka re ba dang*/ grang ba'i nang na tsha ba dong nang gi me lta bu dang*/ snyi ba'i nang na sra ba chu nang gi rdo lta bu dang*/ 'jam pa'i nang na rtsub pa dar nang gi tsher ma lta bur 'ong ngo*/ /skyi la yod na pags bu chag pa 'dra ba cig 'ong bas de la thog tu me bya | spyir dang po sman btang bas skrangs zhi nas lhag ma zhi dka' na bsregayang zhi ru ma 'dod na gnyan sbyong bya/ zhi sla na sman sbyor byas pas chogabasreg mi dgos thub na skrangs pa 'dal du 'gro/ 'chi ba'i rtags ni skrangs pa phyogs med du 'gro ba dang*/ skrangs pa gyen la 'gro ba dang*/ skrangs pa la khrag gi chu bur sngon po 'ong ba dang*/ bcos ka ci byas kyang rdugs pa dang*/ glo chung lu ba dang*/ skad 'gag cing tsi tsi zer na don snod la song ba yin pas/ pho ba lhen zhabs su na zhing zug mi chog na 'chi rtags yin no/ /'di la byer zhud mi 'ong ste | rgya la byung na rta bon po dang*/ gu gul nag po/ ra thug gi sprai'i dud pas bdug go /yang brtag pa'i thabs lugs gcig la/ mdog la brtag pa ni/ phal cher smug po 'ong*/ dmar lhong lhong ba 'ong*/ nyi zer la rta rnga bkal ba 'dra ba dang*/ che phyugs kyi long ka'i rtsa 'dra ba yin/ skrangs pa la chu 'ong na yang dkar po yin/ chu ser nag po'am dud khu byung na nag po yin/

spyir chang 'thungs na phra mo yang nag por 'gyur te 'chi/ gnyid bu rkun ma zhes bya ba la lhog ro yang mi 'byung ste/ 'byung ba nam mkha'i rigs yin pas phyi nas nan 'byor drags na rang bzhin gyis 'bros so/ /rtsa ba'i rtsa shin tu gnyan pa yin te/ de ni gnyid po che'i rigs yin no/ /skyes pa'i g.yas su gzung ba dang*/ bud med kyi g.yon du bzung na gnyan no/ /'chi rtags ni dbugs sna thung ba dang*/ rngam pa che ba dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang*/ skom dad che ba dang/ nan dang*/ sman byas kyang skrangs pa rdo lta bu 'ju ru mi 'dod pa dang*/ 'dug sa gcig tu mi tshugs nas gzhan du 'gro snying 'dod pa dang*/ mig rtsa rgod na 'chi'o/ /'tsho rtags ni rtsa dang chu gnyis ka mi tsha la/ dang ga bde zhing skom dad che na 'tsho'o/ / myur du skrangs pa la mkhris pa skyugs pa dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang*/ mod la rdo ltar skrangs nas dmar zhing khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ mod la chu rkyal bus pa ltar 'ong ba dang*/ gong ltar mnan yang bem bem byed pa dang*/ smre sngags 'don na mi bzang ste gso bar dka'o/ /skrangs pa med cing na tsha che la mnan na 'og nas 'phar zhing 'khyug na tsha lhog nag po sdom pa y-in no/ /yang lag mthil me'i 'khor lo la zhugs na gnyan pa yin pas me btsa' bya/ bag phye'i 'ol skam dang*/ btsan dug sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /de'i steng du phying pas them bya'o/ /yang rkang mthil rtsa'i 'khor lo la byung na gnyan pas btsan dug dang*/ bag phye slad la sbyar ba de'i steng du phying pa btang ba thag pas dam du bsdam mo/ /skrangs pa'i mgo gang byung du bug pa gtod do/ /sha gnyan dang*/ rtsa gnyan la zhugs na nyen che ste/ rtse mgo dang*/ don snod kyi rtsa thams cad nyen che'o/ /sha dang rus pa'i bar du zhugs na dkar la 'tsher ba 'ong*/ sha la zhugs na skrangs pa che/ pags pa la zhugs na 'bros skyen/ skyi la zhugs na grod par chu blugs pa dang 'dra ste/

mchongs shing 'bros te gso dka'o/ khong sman ma btang ba'i gong du skyer pa'i bar shun gyi thang btang ngo*/ khong tshad shin tu che bar skyes na bzang drug bsil gsum btang ngo*/ khong sman gla rtsi/ gur gum/ shing kun gsum/ ru rta/ shu dgabrag zhun gsum/ a ru ra/ dom mkhris/ rgya tshwa gsum/ sgog skyas mgo bsdus ri lu bya/ khor gsum btang na shi ba bzlog ces pas nad kyi babs dang sbyar la btang ngo*/ /phyi'i byug pa'i sman la gnyis te/ sman nan dang*/ ngan nan no/ / sman nan ni/ stag sha ba/ spru ba/ thar nu/ ra dug pa/ dha du ra/ chu rtsa/ dud pa/ khye'u lo brgyad pa'i dri chu la sbyar la byug go /nywa bzhi la byung na sman byugs pa'i steng du ba'i lci ba drod ma yal bar glan/ de'i steng du dkris ma bya'o/ /ngan nan ni | khyi nag po'i so/ phag pa'i ril ma/ spyang ki'i so/ bya phug ron gyi brun/ ra dug brdungs pa'i phye ma/ ba lci/ mi'i dri chen/ dri chu/ rko mo'i sa myag rnams byis pa'i chur sbyar nas byugs na mi thub pa med do/ /rma dang chu bur gyi steng du sman mi bsku bar bzhag chu bur la re lcag bsregs pa'i thal ba skam rtsir gdab/ chu rtsa dang*/ ngan mkhris sna tshogs zho dang sbyar nas byugs na skam rtsi'i mchog yin no

| | yan lag gi dang po mgo la zhugs na skra bregs la/ ra dug pa/ bong nga nag po/ spyang tsher ba/ dha du ra/ stag sha ba'i nan bya/ rtsa'i rgyal po rtse'u chung la zhugs na snying la 'bros pas bla 'chol yang yang 'ong ste/ de la khong sman myur du gtang | phyi nas nan sbyor/ zhag 'ga' mi bya'o/ /gre ba la zhugs na tig gu lam khar skyes dang*/ g.yu ldum dang*/ gser ldum dang*/ mchong ldum dang*/ rgya tshwa rnams sbyar nas dngos po la byugs na thub nges so/ /yang na ser po gsum zhes bya ste/ yung ba dang*/ shu dag dwa ba ser po dang*/ rgya tshwa rnams zhib par byas la/ dngos po la bus na the tshom med do/ /spyir gnyan rigs gang yin yang spyod lam dang zas spyod ni/ rta mi zhon/ chu mi brgal/ bud med dang mi nyal/ me tshad dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ nyin mo'i gnyid spang*/ mi nus pa'i ngal dub dang*/ drag shul spang*/ zas sha chang dang*/ bu ram dang*/ snum bag dang*/ dkar dang*/ tsha dang*/ sran ma dang*/ sgo nga spang ngo*/ /drus thug dang*/ mar btul ba'i zhun mar dang*/ skom du chu bsdus btang ngo*/ /rang bsrung ba ni/ gla rtsi shing kun shu dag gsum/ /ru rta gu gul mu zi gsum/ /lus la bcang na bsrung ba'i mchog/ ces dang*/ yang na nag po dgu sbyor gyi bsrung ba ni/ btsan dug thar nu spru ba gsum | | ra dug ri sho mu zi gsum/ /brag spos mtshal bsregs phag sna gsum | | gag lhog bsrung ba'i gdams pa'o/ /yang gre ba'i sman lugs gcig ni/ gag pa mthong skyugs zhes bya ste/ thar nu 'o mar btul ba dang*/ stag sha ba dang*/ chu rtsa dang*/ dom mkhris te/ de med na phyi ba'i mkhris pa che bar gtang ngo*/ /a ru ra/ dbyi mong*/ rgya tshwa bag tsam zhig zhib par byas la sbu gus gtang ngo*/ /de'i rjes la chan tshogs gtang ngo*/ /mdor na 'ubs kyis bsdus na lus po phrum ser khyer la mgo bo dang tshigs gzhi na ru 'ong*/ rus pa la zhugs na na kar kar 'ong*/ rtsa la zhugs na tsha bring bring 'ong*/

sha la zhugs na na bem bem 'ong*/ skyi la zhugs na rtse lhan lhan 'ong*/ de thams cad khong sman 'dis chog thar nu g.yang sar brkos pa'i 'og ma'i nang du btso/ 'o ma thar nu la thim pa dang*/ nyin gcig nyi ma la skems/ de nas grib skam byas la/ chu rtsa rkang gcig pa g.yang sar brkos pa grib skam byas pa dang*/ srang la cha mnyam la rtsi bzhin btags te gri rtse re lce thog tu bzhag la/ chus phul la gtang ngo*/ /de nas drod la bsgor te skyug tu ma bcug pas cung zad nas 'khru'o/ /'khru ru ma 'dod na gri rtse phyed bsnan la gtang ngo*/ /rang ngam gzhan srung bar byed na ras kyi khud du phur la snas dri mnam/ des ro khur yang mi 'gos so/ /sman ma zhu bar pho ba na na yos dugs bya/ mal chas gtib bo/ /sgal tshigs gzer zhing na na rlung gzer yin pas bsku mnye bya/ kha zas dang spyod lam gong dang 'dra'o/ / yang na me tog lug ru dmar po'i rtsa ba dus su brkos pa dang*/ stag sha ba gnyis zhib par btags la/ chang sgo nga gang la sbyar la khong du gtang ngo*/ /de ni chang la kha drangs nas gsod pa yin te/ lhog pa khong gsod kyi man ngag go /phyi ru 'o ma la sbyar la byug go /srung ba byed pa la lus la gdags/ khong du yang gtang ngo*/ /nyam nga med pa'i gso dpyad yin no/ /sna nas chu ser dkar po byung na klad pa la song ba yin no/ kha'am/ sna nas chu ser dmar po byung na mchin pa la song ba yin no/ /sna nas chu ser re'u'i gcin 'dra ba byung na mi sos so/ kha dang sna nas she rul byung na yang ngan no/ kha nas byung na bag drag lag pa 'dar zhing rngam pa rung rung byed na snying la song ba yin/ glo ba rdzongs pa snyam byed nas mchan khung du zug na glo ba la song ba yin no/ /ci ltar bcos kyang skyed med par kha so la dreg pa chags shing*/ lce la bad ser po'am/ dkar po che ba dang*/ lce'i gzhung nag po la lce rtsub cing skam na mi sos pas spang ngo*/

/de rnams la yang sman gtang na nad mi 'phel lo/ /yang phyi'i lums lugs gcig la/ khyi lud yag ma/ phag pa'i ril ma/ rams/ sgog skya/ gu gul nag po/ mi'i shi skra/ khyi bal/ yugs sa mo'i dor ma bsregs pa'i gzhob/ mi khrag dang*/ dud 'gro'i klad pa gang rnyed la sbyar nas zhag gsum lums byas na skrangs nad thams cad 'joms so/ /yang gre ba'i 'bud sman lugs gcig la/ shu dag a ru ra/ sga dang*/ dud pa/ tsha la rnams sbyar nas bus na/ gre gag sel nges pa'o | | skyes pa pho dar mo dar bsregs pa'i rus pa bsnan yang bzang ngo*/ / dang po thar nu 'dul ba'i thabs ni/ dang po gtub tsa na zho bo ru mi gzhug par gtubs la chang ngam/ 'o ma'am/ chus nub par byas la/ nang du ra sha kham che ba cig bcug la btso/ chang ngam 'o ma thim pa dang*/ ra sha 'og tu gzhug chu thag chod pa dang*/ ra sha sa 'og tu sba/ de nas thar nu skud pa la brgyus la grib skam bya'o/ /nad ol mdud pa la byung na byang ba gshog pa med pa dang*/ re lcag pa/ sha chen rnams khong sman gyi 'phrod du btang ngo*/ /des sos par 'gyur ro | | yang gre ba'i sman lugs gcig la/ ra dug pa cha gcig a ru ra cha gnyis | khron bu/ ldum bu re ral/ mkhan pa'i lo ma gsum ra dug pa tsam re re/ | gla rtsi 'byor pa gcig rgya tshwa/ sbal pa rnga ma can gyi ro/ sha chen rnams sbyar la/ mi dar ma la gri rtse gang gtang*/ lus sbrid la zug che na yang a ru ra'i bsdus thang gtang ngo*/ /'di nang sman zab la legs so/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ gag lhog gso ba'i gdams ngag gnyan nad 'joms pa'i ha la zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so/ / sa māp+ta mi thī// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyan la rigs dgu yod de/ mgo la byung na klad gzer/ og ma la byung na gag pa/ gre ba la byung na thor pa/ snying dang mchin pa la byung na stod gzer | glo ba la byung na glo tshad/

pho ba la byung na pho log rgyu ma la byung na rgyu gzer | rkang pa la byung na nywa byin lhogaphyi rol du skrangs na lhog pa'o/ /de rnams kun gyi spyi'i rtags la/ phrum ser khyer la 'dar zhing grang shum byed/ sgyid pa skyur | kha kha/ dbugs thung*/ gzer drag po byung nas 'gul mi nus pa snyam byed pa byung na yin/ bye brag tu stod gzer la mig ser/ glo tshad la lud pa dmar po dang | ser po dang/ dud khu 'ong*/ rgyu gzer la 'khru ba mdog ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang gu dang*/ nag po dang*/ 'dres pa'i bar du 'khru'o/ /gag pa ni thor pa mi mthong bar gre ba tsi tsi 'byung*/ zug gzer chung*/ thor pa ni mig gis mthong ba na/ dkar po dang*/ smug po dang*/ nag po rnams 'byung*/ kha dog la ni gnyan mi gnyan med/ rdog po che zhing grangs nyung na gnyan/ chung zhing mang na mi gnyan/ phyogs kun nas skrangs na gnyan/ de'i 'og na thor pa chen po yod pa yin/ pho gzer la pho ba sbos par sra na gnyan no/ /nad 'khyug cing yar 'gro mar 'gro byed na mi gnyan/ gzer mi 'pho bar phur pa btsugs pa 'dra na gnyan no | | nywa byin log ni nywa ngar gdong par 'phungs so/ /zug la bsran thabs med pa'o | | lhog pa la 'byung ba bzhi'i brtag thabs yod zer te mi zab/ gang yin yang yan lag gi spu ldog cing snying mi dga'/ drod che/ skrangs mdog gang ltar 'dug kyang mi sto ste/ che zhing snyi na mi gnyan/ me lce ris su yam yam 'dug na mi gnyan/ chung zhing sra na gnyan/ skrangs pa 'phyang na gnyan/ de rnams ni gnyan rigs dgu'o/ /de la yang gnas nges pa med par gzer 'pho ba cig yod de/ de yang smad gzer stod du 'pho na gnyan/ stod gzer smad du 'pho na mi gnyan/ phrum ser khyer ba la sogs pa gnyan/ thog babs su 'ong ba cig yod de/ de dag gang byung yang gnyan pa cig yin no/ /de yang mgo dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ snying ga dang gsum la babs na shin tu gnyan/

gzhan rnams bag mi gnyan/ thams cad kyi rtsa tshad pa gzhan pas 'jam pa cig yod/ thams cad la sman ma btang bar gzer chag na ngan/ dang po gzer cig yod pa lus kun la gram/ zug chung ba snyam byed cing 'gul mi shes par 'khun na ngan/ sna nas chu ser byung na 'chi/ sna khrag byung yang sos pa yod do/ /kun gyi zas kyi bsrung bya ni/ dkar mtha' dag dang*/ mngar skyur mtha' dag spang*/ sha chang spang*/ lto skya na dga' ste/ ldog nyan yod pas bde bar brtas brtas su lto skya bar bya'o/ /spyir gtar ga mi bya/ thog mar ga pur la sogs pa'i bsil sman mi gtang*/ gdon dang bsdongs pas rim gro dang*/ gdon bcos bya/ thab dang bsdongs na thab gdon/ kha la yang thor pa phra mo phal cher 'ong ba yin/ phrum ser khyer ba la sogs pa rim gyis 'ong ba rnams la zhag gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ gsum du nad lci mi lci smin du bcug la sman gtang*/ thog babs rnams la smin ma smin med par sman gtang ngo*/ /sman gyi rim pa ni/ thar nu btul ma'am/ ma btul yang rung ste/ rgyal po yin pas sum gnyis/ chu rtsa rkang gcig pa blon po yin pas sum cha/ hong len btsun mo yin pas che chung mi sto'o/ /de gsum gyis gnyan nad thams cad sos so/ /gal te nad ches nas skyo ba mang ba gtang bar 'dod na/ re lcag pa dkar po/ stag sha ba/ gu gul nag po/ gla rtsi/ shu dag gi wang ste dgu sbyor gyis ni mi sos pa gang yang med do/ /bye brag tu klad gzer la gu gul nag po che bar bya'o/ /thor pa la rgya tshwa gtang*/ gag pa la byang pa cha tshang gi gshog pa dkar po bton pa dang*/ rgya tshwa med thabs med/ stod gzer la kha che gur gum med thabs med do/ /glo tshad la/ li ga dur dang cu gang*/ pho gzer la rgyam tshwa/ nywa byin log la gla rtsi che bar bya'o/ /rgyu gzer la sngar gyi rnam dang bag mi 'dra ste/ gla rtsi/ shu dag dkar po/ gur gum/ gi wang*/ gu gul/ rgun 'brum/ li shi thog gis bsad pa'i rus pa ma bsregs pa de rnams zhib par byas la gtang*/

de ni rgyu ma bsrung bar bya ba yin/ de nas zhag 'ga' 'khru ru bcug pa rang gis chog mi gnyan na bde ru 'gro/ gnyan na sngar gyi sman dgu po de'i steng du thog rus dang bcu sbyar la gtang*/ nad byang nas 'khru ba rang chad du 'gro/ spyir thog rus sker btags pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /lhog pa la phyi ru byung bas nang du khong sman dgu sbyor gtang ba gal che'o/ khong sman ma btang bar byug pa byas pas nad tshabs chung nas bde na yang rnag tu song nas rma chen po 'ong*/ khong sman btang nas phyi ru byug pa ma byas kyang rang zhi ru 'gro/ phyi rol du bsku snying 'dod na sngar gyi sman dgu po las myag dang*/ dur byid gnyis byis pa'i dri chu la sbyar la byuga'akhru skyugs sam/ ri bong gi spus mnan/ mi gnyan pa'i sa ru mngar gyi thig le bya | sman zug na bshal du 'ong*/ des bde nas 'gro gsung*/ mi zug na mi bshal bas sman bskyar la gtang ngo*/ /sman gyis gnyan nad thams cad bsrung ba'i rdzas la/ gser bud med kyis ma reg pa/ shu dag gla rtsi/ gu gul/ sgog skya | de rnams phur ma byas la/ sngags btab la mgul du gdags so/ /bsgom bzlas kyis bsrung ba ni/ skyabs 'gro bya/ byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom | shū n+ya tās stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las a las phag pa dkar po'i khri cig bsgom/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ āḥlas 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po ral gri dang*/ pusti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thugs kar a las zla ba as mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas phag pa dpag tu med par gyur/ de dag gis nad dang gdon thams cad zos nas mtshul pa phyir bstan pa'i ra ba chen po cig bsgom/ de dag la dmigs la sngags bzlas so/ /oṃ nan+ti karma bhis/ dur phag tsha nan/ phu pa sar+b+ba karma rgu karmā zla phur ma ma yu ba yu be ge phaṭa/ ces zhag re la brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs par bzlas so/

/gnyan nad rigs dgu'i bcos ka zab mo/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ thar nu 'dul bar bzhed na/ dpyid dus brkos la mthe'u chung tsam du gtub ste/ zho ma bo bar bya/ de chang gi nang du nub par bya ste/ ra sha kham che ba cig bcug la btso/ chang thar nu la thim pa dang*/ ra sha sa 'og tu bzhagade mi dang dud 'gro gang gis zos kyang 'chi'o/ /thar nu rnams skud pa la brgyus la grib skam bya'o/ /grags rgyal gcung gi bzhed pa ni/ thar nu/ chu rtsa/ shu dgadapa' bo ser po/ dur byid a ru ra/ gu gul/ gla rtsi/ rgya tshwa de rnams zhib par btags la/ khye'u'i chu dang sbyar la btang*/ skyugs pa bsrung*/ 'khru ba rab tu bsngags te nad phyir dbyung*/ dmigs gzhan dud pa dang sbyar/ rgya cher byugadakar dmar/ mngar skyur sha rul ngal dub dang*/ bud med/ nyi ma/ me dang*/ rta | chu/ gnyid rnams spang ngo*/ /log na lums bya/ ro ni mngar khus 'don/ rjes ni zla ba'i bar du ngal dub spang*/ de ru sbyor ba kun 'dus bsrung ba'i mchog kyang yin/ de yis rang zhir ma song dmigs der ga pur ma bsres byugarnag rjes sha bsnyon shu dag gis bcad/ mar khu chen pos byug de'i steng du lums kyis nan bya/ phan par 'gyur/ gre ba'i gag ro mi'i rus pa'i bya 'ur dang | cu gang bag cig bsres pas gre bar btab na sos par 'gyur ro/ /nad yin min brtag pa la/ a ru ra/ thar nu'i thang btang bas/ yin na skrangs 'bur nges par 'ong*/ a ru ra sum cha/ sug smel bzhi cha zhib par btags la gri rtse re tsam khong du btang bas snying skrangs bsrung*/ snying skrangs thub na log pa'i 'jigs pa med/ drag po gtum po shog shing dang*/ /gser gyi me tog ka mo nya/ /maṃ sa ka ra drug 'gyur dang*/ /mi bskyod pa yi rta la bskyon/ /thub pa chen po gal che ste/ /snying la song yang thub par nges/ /sbyar thabs btsan dug ra dug dang*/ /a ru ra gsum lhan cig btags/ /de nas dri chu bar pa dang*//sbyar la rlon btags yun ring bya/

/nag por song na 'byongs pa yin/ /re lcag thar nu lce tsha gsum/ /lhan cig logs su zhib par btags/ /shin tu 'byongs par gyur pa yang*/ kha dog ser po snum par 'gyur/ /thun tshad nad tshabs che chung sbyar | | rtags dang zas spyod gzhan dang mthun/ /thun dang tshad kyi sbyor gnyis las | | 'di ni sbyor ba tshad bcos cig /ser po rta 'dod sbyor ba'o/ /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ lba ba yul 'don gyi gdams pa la/ dung mo cho lo tsam cigasro lo dkar po mtheb tshigs tsam gcig pho ba ris bdun brgyad tsam/ pi pi ling bcu tsam/ sga rdog 'bring gcig rgya tshwa nas tsam gcig sman tsha cho lo tsam gcig lba tsha gzhan bas che ba gcig chang tshod gcig non pa tsam gyi phabs gcig de tsho zhib par brdungs la/ chu bre gang 'o ma'i drod tsam du bsros la/ 'o ma gnon pa bzhin du mnan no/ /ol gong ba nyi shu rtsa gcig nangs ma lnga la wa tshwa btab la lnga gtang*/ phyed nyin bdun la wa tshwa btab la gtang*/ de'i phyed nyin dgu la wa tshwa btab la gtang ngo*/ /de nas sngar gyi sman mnan pa de sbod rtser langs pa dang*/ krol zhing lto stong la gtang ngo*/ /lba ba'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// //༈ chu ser gyi kor le'i khrus la/ ru rta/ byang pa/ spaud/ pho ba ris/ pi pi ling*/ gu gul dkar po/ rgya tshwa zhib par brdungs la/ sdud dpon zo mar gyis byas la chang la bsnur te/ gang chu ser na ba de la bskus te/ nyi ma la 'dug go /de ltar byas pas 'phral la phan par 'gyur ro/ /chu ser kor le'i khrus i thi// //༈ cu gang*/ bong nga*/ khron bu/ shug lo bzhi/ ka ra dkar po'i phye ma gnyis 'gyur du sbyar la/ chu grang rta byas/ tshabs dang sbyar/ ltor gtang*/ tsha ba che na pi pi ling cung zad btang bas gzer ba ma lus 'joms/ mchog tu gyur pa'i gnyen po dam pa yin/ de nyid chu dang sbyar la phyi rol byugs byas na/ skrangs 'joms mchog tu gyur pa'i gdams pa dam pa yin/ sa māp+ta mi thi//

//༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ skran sman gyis bshig pa la/ mi'i mgo rus/ rta'i mgo rus/ khyi'i mgo rus/ phag pa'i mgo rus/ sha ba'i rwa rnams so sor bsregs pa'i thal ba bya/ de'i steng du spen ma/ phur mo'i thal ba dang*/ de rnams zhib par byas la/ grang ba las gyur pa la bu ram/ tsha ba las gyur pa la ka ra la sbyar la lto stong la gtang ngo*/ /des ni skran gyi rigs thams cad rang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /shin tu zab pa'i sman sbyor/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ glo ba las rnag skyugs pa la/ shing mngar dang shing tsha gnyis/ ru rta dang star bu gnyis/ li ga dur dang pi pi ling gnyis/ de rnams cha bsnyams la

| rta'i 'o ma la sbyar la lto stong la gtang ngo*/ /mang nyung nad pa'i nad babs che chung dang shed che chung sbyar ro/ /dkar po gyen 'dren zhes bya ba'i rnag skyugs shin tu zab pa/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ rims nad bsrung ba'i man ngag ni/ gla rtsi gi wang shing kun gsum | | shu dag bong nga a ru ra/ /sgog skyas bsdus la ri lu bya/ /gzer thung rims nad thams cad thub/ /gi wang bdun pa zhes bya ste/ /ri lu re yis zhag bdun thub/ /lto stong dag la re re gtang*/ /de la nyam nga the tshom med/ /rje btsun chen po'i zhal gyi gdams pa shin tu zab bo/ /thar nu sum gnyis/ ra dug pa sum cha/ a ru ra zhib par btags la/ bu ram mam/ 'o ma dang sbyar la thang ka la glan/ de nas lto stong la so rtsa mngar tsam re myang*/ des rims nad thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu byis rims thub par 'gyur ro/ /yang maṇ+ḍal gcig gi steng du/ dbus su 'jam dpal gyi rten yung ba/ g.yas su spyan ras gzigs kyi rten shu dag g.yon du phyag na rdo rje'i rten bong nga nag po cig bzhag la | sngags 'di bzlas so/ /oṃ thim ta ra sa dun+t-i dz+wa la raṃ pa ye swā hā/ zhes rang bsrung ba la lnga brgya/ gzhan bsrung ba sum brgya bzlas la/ yung ba'i phur ma dbus/ shu dag g.yas/ bong nga g.yon du byas la mgul du gdags so//des rims nad thams cad thub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i gdams pa zab bo/ /rje btsun chen po'i zhal gdams so// //༈ gsum gyi sbyor ba'i man ngag la/ bong nga nag po cha gcig la/ a ru ra drug log btang la lcag phor du dri chu la yun ring du sbyangs la ril bu bya/ gag lhog la ril bu lnga lnga chus 'phul la gtang*/ rjes la mngar dang dkar dang skyur spang ngo*/ /bong nga nag po dang dzā ti dum gcig a ru ra gser mdog bdun 'gyur snying rlung la gtang*/ bong nga nag po/ a ru ra bdun 'gyur/ shu dag ru rta/ dū ba/ sgog skya/ byis pa'i dri chen/

dri chu de rnams sbyar la/ lhog pa la phyi'i byug nan bya'o/ /bong nga*/ shu dag ba bla/ chu rtsa/ ru rta/ gre ba'i gag pa la gtang ngo*// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rims bsrung ba rin po che'i gdams pa'i lugs 'di la sman 'di rnams so/ /bong nga nag po/ mu zi/ gu gul nag po/ spru ba'i rtsa ba | shing kun/ gla rtsi/ ldong ros/ ba bla/ stag sha ba/ dri chen/ dri chu/ ra dug pa/ rwa gzhob 'di rnams legs par btags la/ thum bu byas la/ dri sna bug tu gtang ngo*/ /nad tshabs chen po la 'ju na dri chu la sbyar la nad 'gos pa'i sgo dgu thig le bya/ bsrung ba la mi 'gom par bya'o/ /sngags kyis bsrung ba la/ oṃ ma taṃ gho bhis che ni swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas so/ /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi yang thigs zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag 'di la dom mkhris/ chu rtsa/ sha la g.yu ri/ bong nga dkar po rnams cha mnyam/ de rnams kyi cha phyed kar gtang*/ mtshal ka ra'i phyed/ rgya tshwa mtshal gyi phyed/ de rnams zhib par btags la/ khye'us 'thungs pa'i nu zhos sprus la/ ri lu dung ya kod 'bring po tsam byas la sba'o/ /lha ba bye ba la bdar la gtang*/ dar thog tu rnag shor ba la gseng gtod la gtang*/ 'bras la bsregs la gdab bo/ /rma rtsi reg 'byor zhes bya ba i thi// //༈ yang lugs gcig la/ rdo smug po sbal rgyab/ bong nga dkar po'i rtsa ba/ lo ma/ dom mkhris/ mi mkhris/ tsha la rnams zhib par btags la btang na rma rtsi shin tu zab bo/ /de'i steng du tsan+dan dkar po btang na rdo rje dang 'dra'o | | yang na/ sbal rgyab/ mtshal/ mkhris chen gsum btang yang bzang ngo | | yang dag pa'i gdams ngag sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya'i lums bcos kyi man ngag 'di la/ gu len gyis lha ba 'dzin/ nye 'byed kyis hral hrul gcod/

dmar khrag gis sha'u bskyed/ hri dmar gyis rtsa kha sdoms/ rdo smug gis cha snyoms so/ /klad pa 'dzag na klad them gzhugaklad them nang du sman gyis mnan/ de'i steng du dar dmar po gtang*/ de'i steng du rma chas dang ras 'jag gis dkri/ phye thug mar gsar btab la gtang*/ zho gtang | sha tshod dang sbyar/ tsha ba skyes na bzang drug dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po sbyar la btang/ grang rlung skyes na bu ram rnying pa dang*/ chang bsres la gtang*/ spyod lam gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di ni lus mgo mjug gi rma gsar rnying thams cad la bdud rtsi dang 'dra'o/ /i thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgo bo'i lums bcos kyi man ngag la/ rdo smug po sbal rgyab dang*/ sa kha bu ram dang*/ 'gro rten zhag chen dang*/ hi dam dang*/ nye 'byed dang sbyar la | mthu sbyor zhes bya ba yin pas thun tshad la nges pa med do/ /de nas rus pa skyung bus brad do/ /rma kha len pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de nas sman btab la/ rma kha dar gyis bcad do/ /sbang ma dang ras 'jag gtang ngo*/ /des skyon gang yod kyang tshegs med par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ khyad par can gyi gdams ngag sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmu chu 'phrul gyi 'dzag skems zhes bya ba 'di la dmu chu dang*/ 'or dang | dmu rdzing la sogs pa las bsdus pas dkar nag gnyis su 'dus so/ / ske dang rkang lag skrangs pa dang*/ gsus pa che ba dang*/ lus zungs chung ba ni dmu rdzing nag po yin pas spang bar bya'o/ /lus skrangs pa dang*/ gsus pa che ba dang | rkang lag skrangs pa dang res che res chung byed pa ni dmu chu dkar po yin pas mkhas pas gso bar bya'o/ /de la dang po dugs bya/ de nas sman sbyar ba ni | ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi gsum gtso bo yin no/ /dur byid dong ga sngon bu gsum rno ba'i sman gsum mo/

/yung ba skyer pa ser po khrag rkang gsum ser po gsum mo/ /dbyi mong tsi tra ka lce tsha ba gsum ni sngo gsum mo/ /rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa gsum ni tshwa gsum mo/ /'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling lcam pa gsum ni kha 'dzin gsum zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang tshwa sna tshogs tshad gtang ste/ rwa tshwa/ shing tshwa | lce myang tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ thal tshwa la sogs rnyed tshad gtang ngo*/ /de rnams mar dkar la sbyar la/ khye sus kyi dus su khyem bu do gsum gtang ngo*/ /zhag dang po la khyem bu gsum gtang*/ des rtsa lam dang*/ chu lam nas chu ser bre do tsam 'dzag go /de nas skrangs pa'i 'ju stobs dang*/ chu'i 'dzag stobs sbyar te/ khyem bu re re tsam gtang*/ chu nyung na khyem bu gsum tsam/ pho bas thul mi thul lta zhing gtang*/ de nas zhag brgyad tsam du khyem bu re re gtang*/ 'phral la nyams tshad cing ma btang na/ dus gcig la rdol nas nad pa 'chi ba yin no/ / gzabs nas legs par bcos nas myur du 'tsho ba yin no/ /rjes bcad pa bshal dang 'dra/ des ni 'dzag cing skems par byed do/ /dmu chu 'phral 'dzag ces bya'o/ /'dzag par mi shes par skems pa ni/ chu'i gag pa bsdams pa dang 'dra ste 'chi'o/ /dmu chu 'phrul gyi 'dzag skems zhes bya ba i thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sha dug gi sngags la/ oṃ hri ma hūm̐/ ka ru te ma ya na ma kriṃ kriṃ sod swā hā | tho rangs gangs chu rnyog med la/ /smra ba bcad de ci nus bzlas/ /tshugs tshad nad pa dag la gtang*/ /langs pa shar gyi nad rnams 'joms/ /e ma ho/ i thi// //༈ glang rog po rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na gang gis kyang btub ste/ de'i mkhris pa ma nyams pa cig chu la sbyangs la gtang ngo*/ /glang gi mkhris pa gcig gis mi gcig thon pa yin no/ /sha dug gi sman gyi mchog yin no/ /yang nas yang du rtags thon pa yin no/ /btsan dug tsha bul med pa zhib par btags la chu bzang po la 'dur la btab nas 'thungs na btsan dug dang*/

sha dug rdo rje bzhin 'joms so/ /zab bo/ /dug nad gso ba la/ khyim gsar gyi bu mig ma bye ba'i sha grib skam byas te/ dbang po lnga dang*/ don snying lnga dang*/ yan lag bzhi so sor phral te ma nor bar bskams/ lus thams cad na na sha thams cad las bsdus la gtang*/ don snod so so na na gang na ba ma nor bar byas la btags/ gangs chu la sbyar la gtang*/ sman zho rer nangs ma bdun gyi bar la btang na thub bo/ /dug 'dred ni/ a ru ra zur lnga dang*/ bud med gzhon nu ma dug dang rims dang mchin pa'i nad kyis ma shi ba'i mchin pa ma rul ba/ ma bam pa/ bud med ma gsar gyi bu khye'u skyes pa'i ro tshan dang gsum mnyam por sbyar la/ tho rangs chang gis phul la gtang ngo*/ /thun tshad theb snying gang gtang ngo*/ /lto nyi ma phyed las mi bza'/ des lo gcig the tshom med par thub bo/ /so pa ni bong nga nag po nas tsam cig zhib par btags te chu la sbyar/ lce la bsku zhing nyi ma la gdung*/ de nas lce ber langs dran pa med tsam na/ a ru ra nas tsam drug btab la khong du gtang*/ zla ba phyed tshun la sbyor ba gang byung yang lce ber 'ong*/ bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs pa'o/ /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cong zhi'i gdams pa ni/ dang po cong zhi bzang po drus phye tsam du btags la/ chang ngam/ sham po la btab la/ sags nas lbu ba tsir tsir byung ba de rnams gzar bus byabs la skyur ro/ /de nas nub gcig bzhag pa grungs pa de ras gtsang ma'i khud du gtums/ ras gcud la btsir/ de nas nang gi rtsigs ma de ras kyi khud du bkram la/ steng nas ras rkyang pas bkab la nyi ma la bskam/ bskams pa de rang thag bzang po la nyis thags byas la/ de la pi pi ling | pho ba ris gnyis/ sga rdog phyed/ rgyam tshwa ril ma tsam gcig a ru ra rdog po gcig bad kan smug po la ka ra dkar pos bya/ skya bo la bu ram dang sbyar nas na ba'i dus na nyin gcig la yang nam na tsa na gtang la/

mi na na 'phro gcod pa yin te 'di dkar 'dul zhes bya ba khyad par can gyi gdams ngag ga/ོ 'di gtang ba'i sngon du la phug tsha mig zhib par brdungs la chu ldur ba brdungs nas 'dred du song nas nad du 'gro mi srid do/ /ma zhu ba snyam byed na yungs rdog re re bca'/ rtsa 'gags na rang gi dri chu gtang*/ lcom pa'i thang gtang*/ dam tshig tu 'di bsten pa'i dus su mar nag dang*/ snum khur mi bza'o/ /spyir nad bad kan la rgyam tshwa gsum pa'i thang gtang*/ de nas sbyang gtang ngo*/ /de nas 'di'i sbyor ba bsten na gang yang sos so/ khyad par mchog tu gyur pa'i gdams ngag rdo chu'i gdams ngag ni/ mo cong bzang po mgar ba'i sol mer bsregacu gang bzang po'i chu la skyur ro/ /de'i chu des bsku byug byas pas so dam pa dang | lus rdo rje bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /tshe nyi zla lta bur 'gyur/ stobs che/ mdangs rma bya dang 'dra/ mig gis tshangs pa'i gnas mthong*/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma med ro tsa bar byed do/ /gzhan yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas 'byung*/ i thi// //༈ ro stod tsha khong nge na ba/ nas chang 'jam po la cong zhi btab la gtang | des sel lo/ /dzā ti/ cong zhi sbyar nas gtang na snying rlung sel lo || brag zhun ril ma tsam cig cong zhi dang sbyar nas btang na bad kan dang*/ dug thams cad kyi nad sel lo/ /cong zhi dang spang rgyan dkar po'i rtsa ba'am/ me tog dang sbyar nas btang na gre ba'i nad la phan no/ /brag zhun 'dul ba'i thabs ni/ brag zhun khram khrum du brdungs la chu la gdab/ de nas bra ba'i ril ma gzhibs la skyur/ de nas yang dkrugs la dar gcig na ril ma bzhagade nas dwangs ma bzhur la me la bsdu/ de lta bur song ba dang nyi ma la skam mo || 'brum nag gis gre ba 'thams na dngul chu dug ma bton pa dang*/ gla rtsi dang ra khrag sbyar nas btang bas/ 'brum nag ma thon pa rnams phyir 'byung bar 'gyur ro/

/yang 'brum pas gre ba 'gags pa la/ bong nga nag po sum gnyis/ a ru ra sum cha sbyar nas gre bar btab ste cung zad cig na hag byas pas sangs nas 'gro'o/ /dngul chu'i dug 'don pa ni/ tsha bslad pa'i mchil ma dang bsnur bas g.ya' gud du 'ong ngo*/ /yang na star bus kyang ngo*/ /rgyam tshwa dang*/ gla rtsi cha bsnyams nas zhib par btags te/ ling tog la btab na myur du sel lo || gnyan rigs kyi nad 'joms pa'i khong sman ni/ ra dug zho gcig khron bu zho gnyis/ shug pa tsher ma can gyi lo ma zho gcig sbyar nas btang na gag pa/ lhog pa/ gzer thung*/ gnyan rigs kyi nad ngan tsam sel lo/ /sbrum ma la btang na bu 'chor ro/ /'di ni khyad par gyi gdams pa'o/ /oṃ ra da ra sod/ du ra sod/ char char/ chir chir/ srin bu mgo dmar sod/ ces so/ /srin la chu rtsa sran ma tsam gsum la sngags brgya brgya so sor btab la/ so na pa'i bar du mnan no/ /mig gi srin bu la/ gyo mo gsar pa la brgya btab la/ dar tshags la btsags nas dgab/ khong srin la ba'i 'o ma la tsha btab la bskol te sngags mang du btab la ltor gtang ngo*/ /lan 'ga' btang ngo*/ /srin bshal btang na rang gi dri chu la tsha zhib po tshul cig btab la me la bskol/ grang ba dang 'thungs te mal chas byibs la nyal/ cung zhig na srin thams cad 'byung ngo*/ /des lo dus sam zla phyed thub bo/ /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chu skyes 'o 'dzag dang*/ /blon po gser gyi sdong po gnyis || 'bangs ni rin chen chus sbyangs nas/ /gzer thung ma lus zhi bar byed | | ces pa thar nu 'o mar btul ba'am/ ma btul yang rung ste/ chu rtsa rkang gcig pa dang cha bsnyams la sbyar/ rtsi bzhin du btags nas chu la sbyar nas btang na gzer gyi rigs thams cad dang*/ gnyan rigs 'gos sla ba thams cad 'joms so/ /de'i steng du skyob sbyor bar 'dod na/

tsha ba che na hong len sum cha/ 'jam por 'dod na sha chen bag tsam gtang ngo*/ /don snod kyi kha 'dzin ni/ snying la nad babs na dzā ti/ glo ba la cu gang*/ mchin pa la gi wang dang brag zhun/ mcher pa la li shi mkhal ma la sug smel/ mkhris pa la gser gyi me tog dang tig ta/ de rnams kha 'dzin so sor btang na nad gang yin pa 'joms so/ /skyug tu mi gzhug go /drod la bsgor/ pho ba cung zad na na yos dugs bya/ des nad thams cad 'khru bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig 'khrus nas chu skol mang du gtang ngo*/ /'di khyad par gyi gdams pa'o/ /i thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang khog rin po che'i rnag skems 'di la dngul chu zho gcig mu zi srang gnyis/ a ru ra tshum gcig de rnams zhib par btags la rang gi dri chus sbyar te/ rdza so btang ba'i nang du mu zi ma btul ba srang gcig 'og tu bting*/ de'i steng du zangs srab po glebs la bzhag de'i steng du dngul chu blugs/ de'i steng du mu zi srang gcig gis zangs khyab par g.yogs/ kha chod 'grigs par byas pa'i steng du bug pa byas la/ 'dag pa dang lci ba bsres pas dud pa mi 'chor bar dgag spang bzang po'i mes bsreg go /tshos ma tshos blta ba ni/ bug pa na mar lcags phra mo gcig brgyab pas sob kyis song na tshos pa yin/ ma phed na bskyar la bsreg go /tshos pa dang*/ zangs dang*/ dngul chu 'dres pas sngo leb pa ba cig 'ong*/ sngo skyar 'dug na shin tu tshos pa yin/ smug por 'dug na ma tshos pa yin/ thal ba de dang*/ yung ba dang*/ pa to la dang*/ li ga dur dang

| so ma ra dza dang*/ thal ka rdo rje dang*/ rgya ru dang*/ bse ru dang*/ gwa dor dang | de rnams zhib par btags la/ sbrang gis ri lu byas la/ dang po ril ma tsam gtang*/ de nas gsum mam gnyis zho re/ de nas lus kyi tshod dang sbyar la ci rigs par gtang ngo*/ /byang khog rnag gis khengs kyang sos par 'gyur ro/ / rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byis pa'i mchin nad bcos pa'i thabs la/ dang po brtag pa ni/ sha tsha la rtsa mi bde ba dang*/ dbugs thung la rngam pa ring thung byed/ mig ldog cing 'dzums pa dka'/ mig sngo la lus 'dar ba/ lag pa gnyal nas 'degs pa dka' ba/ sha ser ba/ bol gong dang*/ mig gi ya phug yo ba/ rkang mthil dang lag mthil ser ba/ nad ldang dub byed/ pho ba sbo/ chu sdom/ chu mdog dmar ba'am/ ser po 'ong*/ 'khru skyugs byed/ skabs su 'khun du 'ong*/ snga dro dang dgongs ka bde/ de ltar 'dug na mchin pa'i rtags so/ /bcos pa'i thabs ni/ gur gum/ brag zhun/ cu gang*/ dzā ti/ dom mkhris/ tig ta/ a ru ra rnams ka ra dkar po drug 'gyur dang sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /'khru ba la phye thug tshos po la sug smel kha tshar btab la gtang ngo*/ /zas rul sums dang*/ bshul sha mtha' dag spang*/ chang la sogs pa tsha ba skyed pa'i zas rnams spang*/ spyod lam drag shul mtha' dag spang ngo*/ /byis pa'i mchin nad bcos thabs so// sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ pho log la/ dha du ra'i 'bras bu dang*/ sgog skya gla rtsi rnams zhib par byas la/ khye'u'i dri chu la yun ring du sbyangs/ ril bu sran ma tsam byas la/ pho lhog glo bur 'byung na ri lu gcig btang*/ des ma phan na yang gcig gtang*/ de phan chad mi dgos so/ /mig zi ba'am/ shes pa spun pa byung na mar bzhu ba thum bu phyed tsam btang bas bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bu tsha dang sha ma ma thon pa la/ khyi'am spyang ki'i brun/

bya bal ma/ mdze tshwa sbyar nas sham po la btab nas btang bas bu tsha dang sha ma thon par 'gyur ro/ /bong nga ril ma phyed tsam/ bu ram srang phyed dang sbyar la ri lu sran ma tsam byas la/ zhag re la re re zos na grang ba dang*/ snying rlung zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrag chod chen po'i gdams ngag la/ mtshe'i rtsa ba dang lo mar bcas pa brdungs la sham pa la btso/ khu ba logs su bzhur zhing khaṇ+ḍar bsdu/ de la tshos spar gang dang*/ zhu mkhan spar gang zhib par btags la blugs/ ska ldog song ba dang*/ ngad ma yal ba la dom mkhris dang*/ shing tsha zhib par btags la/ de nas ri lu byas te/ bu ram la rta byas la gtang*/ gcig gis ma chod na gnyis nas gsum gyi bar du gtang ngo*/ /de nas rma gang du byung yang khrag chod do/ /sna khrag mi zad pa yang chod do/ /nges pa'o/ /glo bur du sbyong na tshe'i khaṇ+ḍa khyor gang la gong gi sman btab la khong du btang bas chod nges so/ / yang sna khrag gcod pa'i lugs gcig la/ dom mkhris/ shing tsha/ hong len/ chags ma/ btsod/ gur gum/ de rnams bu ram la rta byas la khong du btang bas rma'i khrag dang*/ sna'i khrag dang*/ mngal khrag mi zad pa dang*/ rtsa chen po chad pa'i khrag thams cad 'chad par nges so/ /rdo 'don na yang zhar la sman za ru bcug pas zan la bzo byed pa lta bu 'byung ngo*// //༈ e ma ho/ byis rims bsrung ba'i gdams ngag la/ dro gang skar ma ma sangs pa la/ rgyug chu mda' la ma slebs pa'i nang nas lag pa rjen pas ma reg par rde'u chu dang bcas pa blangs la/ bud med dang phrad na de pho la yang blang | bud med med pa'i sa ru rde'u de la sngags brgya re bzlas la/ de'i dus su yang lag pas mi reg par dar dmar po'i khud du gtums la mgul du btags pas thub bo/ /sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ nir sing yer rbad swā hā/ byis rims bsrung ba yid ches nyams su myong ba'o//

//༈ yang byis rims bsrung ba'i lugs gcig shog bu mtshon gang la sngags 'di dmar nag gis gzab tu bris la bzhi bltab tu bya/ rgya skyegs dang | btsod dang*/ zhu mkhan gsum bag tsam re nang du blugs la/ skyi dmar gyis g.yogs te/ dbu gyen la bstan la gdags so/ /sngags 'di lan bdun dang | rten 'brel gyi sngags bdun gyis rab gnas bya'o/ /oṃ kun dha le baṃ laṃ bruṃ shal shal swā hā/ lag len du ma byas pa yin no/ /i thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyan nad la khaṇ+ḍa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba 'di la/ rgyal po mdangs dang ma bral ba/ /zhes bya ste/ chu rtsa nus pa che dus su brkos pa'i rlon pa chang la btsos pa'i khaṇ+ḍa ru bsdu/ btsun mo nu zho dang ma bral ba/ /zhes bya ste/ thar nu nus pa che dus su brkaus pa'i rlon pa 'o ma la khaṇ+ḍar bsdus la/ de gnyis gcig tu bsres la legs par dkrugs/ de nyi ma la bskams la rlon pa grod par blugs la thog la gdags/ lo dus lon pa bzhin du nus pa che ru 'gro'o/ /de nas ril ma tsam re btang bas bshal skyug gnyis ka 'byung ste/ nus pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ste tshad med do/ /gre ba'i thor pa la dbyi mo'i myu gu'i lo ma grib ma la bskams te/ sbu gus bud do/ /des zhi bar 'gyur ro/ khyad par phul du phyin pa'i gdams ngag go /sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bzad gnyan nad skrangs pa la/ /gcig thub nag po khong du gtang | | dmigs bu mtheb gong stong par bzhag /phyi yi nan gyi man ngag la// skrad rnying ra ru bsregs pa'i gzhob/ khyi spu ra spu bsregs pa'i gzhob/ /sog pa'i me long bsregs pa'i gzhob/ /ro yi skra bsregs gzhob dang ni/ /sha chen dang ni stag sha ba/ /chu rtsa dang ni thar nu dang*/ /sa myag dang ni khyi lud rnams/

/ dri chus lug zho tsam sbyar la/ /lan gnyis lan gsum byug par bya/ /skrangs nad ma lus 'joms pa ste/ /mchog tu lhog pa dag la shis/ khyad par can gyi man ngag i thi/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag go/ //༈ 'bras la sngags 'di btab pas gting nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// oṃ nyi ma 'jar dha sha zhes btang bas myur du 'tsho'o/ /yang nas yang du rtags thon pa yin/ lcags kyi phur pa brgya zhig sib sib nad la sib/ gdungs gdungs nad la gdungs/ khroṃ khroṃ nad la khroṃ/ zangs kyi phur pa brgya zhigasib sib nad la sib/ gdungs gdungs nad la gdungs/ khroṃ khroṃ nad la khroṃ/ zhes lcags phur sor bzhi/ zangs phur sor bzhi pa gnyis gangs chu la ngar btab la/ rkang pa'i dreg gang na ba'i steng du dril zhing sngags bzlas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis gsor gyis shing la phigs pa ltar bsam/ sngags 'di 'debs pa'i bar la smra bcad bya/ dam tshig tu 'debs pa'i bar la chang dang bud med spang*/ rkang pa'i dreg na ba'i sngags yang nas yang du rtags thon pa yin gsung*/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ gzer bcos pa'i man ngag la/ rlung gzer 'pho zhing yang bas nye'u dang*/ bu ram btang*/ bsku mnye bya'o/ khrag gzer ni las drag dal gyis gzer 'dril nas 'ong bas bsil thang gtang*/ gtar ga bya/ gnyan gzer ni mgo bo na/ tshigs bzhi khol/ snying mi dga'/ tshig pa za bas de la chu rtsa sum gnyis dang*/ thar nu sum cha la mi sha skam po thar nu tsam cig sbyar la btang ngo*// de rnams kyis zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gzer rigs thams cad spyir 'joms pa'i sman ni/ kha lce 'joms pa'i me tog dang*/ /dngos gzhi gsod pa'i me tog dang | | mtha' shing mu la dri ldan dang*/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bdud rtsi dang*// ka ra dkar po sbyang la gtang*/ /gzer rigs thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro | khyad par gyi gdams ngag i thi// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/

/mchu'i bad kan la/ a ru ra/ chu rtsa/ rdo pha bong cho lo dang*/ bu ram rnams zhib par btags la/ chu gtsang la sbyar te srod la mchu la bsku'o/ / yang lugs gcig la/ a ru ra dang*/ bu ram gnyis bud med kyi nu zho la me long gi steng du bsnur la mchu la bsku/ steng nas dar dmar pos dgab bo/ / so'i srin la/ mar nag la sgog skya btab la/ dung gis dkrug cing*/ sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad btab la/ so gang na ba'i ngos kyi rna bar blug go /nā ga srin sod | nā ga srin thon/ zhes pas phan nges so/ /pho log la thar nu/ sha chen/ ka ra gsum cha bsnyams la/ chang ngam chu la sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /gre ba'i gag pa la/ thar nu/ rgya tshwa/ sbu gus bud na phan no/ /so sra bar bya ba la/ mu zi rang gi dri chu la bsnur la/ so'i phyi nang du mnyes na sra bar nges so/ /sha dug gis gre ba 'gags pa la/ 'dre'i dpal ka'-i 'brum bu dang*/ tsha la zhib par bya ste/ chu la sbyar la gtang na sel nges so/ /'khru skyugs bcad pa'i gdams ngag la/ mon mo rkang chag gi me tog grib skam byas la/ de zhib par btags te/ tsha 'khru la chu la sbyar la btang*/ grang 'khru la chang la sbyar la gtang*/ des 'chad nges so// yang na nas sngon mo tshig mar byas la/ de zhib par btags nas tsha grang gi bye brag gis chu dang chang la sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /des 'chad nges so/ /skyugs pa la sha tshon po'am/ yib ma/ me du ba med pa la rdza'i nang du ma tshig par tshos par bsregs la/ de brdungs la tshod ma bya/ 'bras sna ser tsam du brngos la/ de zhib par btags te thal du gdab/ de lan gnyis lan gsum btang bas 'chad nges so/ /man ngag dam pa sa māp+ta mi thi// //༈ rma la sngags sman gang byas kyang yi dwags kyis 'tsho ru ma ster na bya rog gi brun btags la/ me du ba med pa la bsregs pa'i dud pas rma la bdugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /rab tu gsang ba'i gdams ngag go/ //༈ mgo'i gdams ngag mdor bsdu na/ dang po mkhan pa/

sbang ma/ g.yer ma/ spod rnams sbyar bas sha gdul/ skra bzhar la chings bya/ zhag gsum kha zas bsil du gtang*/ drag shul mi bya/ kha mi sgul/ zhag gsum nas rtsa thog der srub khar tsha lto bya/ rma rgyas na gtar ga bya/ me btsa' tshod dang sbyar/ rma la gting skyon med na rma sman btab la sha chings klod/ rus pa la skyon yod na khrag gcod la sogs pa grabs su bcug la/ bcud la btab nas g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab skyon gang yod ngos dras/ rus skyon bsal/ srin bal gyis lding them bya | de nas spangs chas gtang*/ rma rtsi rma dang khong pa gnyis ka nas gtang*/ rtsa sgo mes bsrungs/ mgo bo la lag tu blang ba de las med do/ /byang khog gi man ngag mdor bsdu na/ dang po khrag gi dus su rgyas ma thog khug bya/ de nas bsil thang gtang*/ chu ser gyi dus su chu ser nag po rol du gsod pa zhes bya ba/ bse ru dang*/ sha ba'i gwa dor bzhur ba dang*/ ga pur/ cu gang*/ ba le ka tig ta/ rgun 'brum/ sug smel/ mtshal/ dom mkhris/ tsan+dan dkar po rnams ka ra dang sbyar nas lto stong la gtang ngo*/ /de ni chu ser rol du gsod pa'i mchogastod smad kyi rtsa bag re gtar ro/ /bzang drug dang*/ kha zas bsil du gtang ngo*// des ma bzlog na rnag tu 'gro bas bkrog thabs gsum bya/ dbye ran na gsang du bsdus la/ phyi'i sha gtsag gis dra/ nang sha sen mos dbug rnag rgyangs kyis byung na legs/ ma byung na sbu gus 'jib/ rnag sla ba dang*/ zhag gsum na 'chad dus yin no/ /lag len dril na de las med gsung ngo*/ /yan lag la dang po bcos te/ lci ba/ sbang ma/ 'khan pa/ bya bra/ dri chus lums bya/ gnad la phog nas lhog thabs su skrangs nas cis kyang ma thub na ra lug gi slo dron mo la btsan dug dang*/ dri chus bran la drod ma yal ba la lums byas na skrangs pa'i rigs thams cad la phan no/ /chu ba dang rgyus pa thams cad chad 'khums su song na/ ba lci dron mo la tshwa dang phabs btab nas/

thog tu lums bya/ des khad kyis bde bar 'gyur ro/ mde'u nang du yod pa'i byi ru chus kha bkru btab pas gzhan rlon par byas nas/ mthe bong gang tsam me la skam/ de'i 'og tu mde'u yod do/ /yan lag gi rma bcos pas red na khyi'i klad pas bdugs na phan no/ /tshigs gzhi lcibs kyis mi 'dul/ skam chas bya/ rma red pa thams cad la shug pa/ ba lu/ mkhan pa gsum zhib par bya ste/ dro byad la mnan/ des kyang ma thub na spyang ka'i brun dkar po dang*/ khyi lud gnyis bsnyams la zho la lde gu byas nas tshan che bar bskus na mi 'chor nges so/ /rkang mthil dang*/ lag mthil la lcibs mi gtang*/ rtsa chad na me gdab/ spyir nad thams cad chu ser las byung ba yin no/ /lag len dril na de las med do// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsha ba gsum gyis tsha ba 'joms/ /dung gis skam tshags sel bar byed | | yung bas rab rib sel bar byed/ /sag rtsis mchi ma gcod par byed// ti tshas 'joms par byed pa yin/ /mar gyis snyoms par byed pa yin/ /da ni sbyar thabs bstan par bya'o/ /tsha ba gsum cha gcig sman lnga po cha mnyam par byas la/ re re yang tsha ba gsum dang cha mnyam par bya'o/ /tsha zug che na tsha ba sum cha bskyed/ skam tshags la dung mang du gtang*/ rab rib che na yung ba mang du gtang*/ mchi ma mang na sag rtsi mang du gtang*/ ti tsha ni kun la snyoms pa yin | mar dang sbyar la/ nub mo nyal ba'i dus su bsku/ nang par chus bkru'o// mig nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mig nad zhi ba'i man ngag zab bo || || ༈ mig la snad ling byung na mthe'u chung dag par bkrus la/ mig snad pa ngos kyi sna bug tu bcug la/ bar gyi krung krung la drag tu brad pas sna khrag 'dod tshad 'byung ngo*/ /des sel lo/ /sna khrag gcod pa dang*/ bud med kyi mngal khrag bcad pa'i sngags la/ oṃ rat+na rat+na/ tsa ti tsa ti/ sid+dhi sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/

sna khrag la byed na/ sna bug gang nas byung ba ngos kyi sna'i khung bur sngags gdab/ des 'chad do/ /mngal khrag la byed na/ chu la mang du bzlas la lto ru gtang*/ des 'chad nges so/ /rtags mang du thon pa y-in no/ /i thi// //༈ bad kan gyi gre ba 'dzer zhing tsha ba la/ lga zhib par btags la/ mar dang sbyar la btang*/ des sel lo/ /mig sngo long ngam/ sngo rib tu song ba la 'bu dung skyogs pa dang*/ ka ra dkar po zhib par btags la/ ri lu byas la sba | de phug ron gyi dong ru g.yas pa'i rtse mo la glan te brad pas sel lo/ /pa tri rgyu lam zhes bya ba'i sngags mang du bzlas te/ sna nas phus btab na cham pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi rgyal po spru ba 'di/ /skye sa spang la bzang ba yin/ /ring thung sor bzhi ran pa yin/ /'dam pa rtsa la 'dam pa yin/ /dri dang kha dog sman gyis bsgyur/ /bu ram dang sbyar khong du btang*/ /de yis khrag rnams 'chad par 'gyur | khrag gcod rgyal po'i sman yin no/ /zab bo// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya nad tsha 'khru rgyu gzer bcos pa'i thabs la/ dkar po gcig thub ces bya ba/ dang po nad des shi ba'i thod pa ma bam pa/ bcud ma shor ba de bdud rtsi dang cha bsnyams la zhib par btags/ de thun gcig rang gi dri chu bar pas rta byas la tho rangs btang na lo gcig thub bo/ /de ni rang gi bsrung ba'o// nyam nga ba dang nad pa'i sa ru 'gro na/ gong gi sman gnyis rang gi dri chu bar pa la tho rangs sbyar la khrus bya'o/ /des nyam nga ba dang 'jigs mi dgos so/ /gso ba'i thabs ni thod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi dang*/ ser po dgu drus dang*/ ka ra'o/ / thod pa dang bdud rtsi cha bsnyams/ de'i phyed dgu drus/ de gsum dang ka ra cha bsnyams la zhib par btags te/ nad tshabs kyi bye brag gis snga dro/ nyin phyed/ dgong ka thun re gtang*/ yang srod tho rangs nyin dgung mtshan dgung bzhi la thun re btang*/

rta dri chu bar pa la bya/ 'di sngon du thengs na mi 'chi nges so/ /de ni dang pos nad gsad pa'o/ /de nas rjes bcad pa ni/ tshad pa zhi nas 'khru ba gtsang la lus shed dang rtsa shed chung tsam na thod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi cha bsnyams la

| tshad pa shas che na ser po dgu drus/ grang ba shas che na sga/ tsha grang mnyam na skyer pa'i bar shun bsnan no/ /de rnams btags la zho btsos la sbyar la lan 'ga' gtang*/ 'dis ma sos na tshe zad pa yin no/ /byis rims gso ba'i gdams pa khyad par can no/ /gre ba'i thor pa la/ a ru ra bzhi/ bong nga ril ma tsam gcig rgya tshwa bong nga tsam gsum/ yung ba kha dog 'gyur tsam gcigade rnams zhib par btags la/ thor pa'i staing du sbu gus blugs/ gla rtsi bag tsam gcig btang na yang bzang ngo*/ khyad par mchog tu gyur pa'i gdams pa'o// rgyas pa'i tsha ba la/ ga pur/ chang bag tsam gcig la sbyar la gtang*/ des ni ga pur 'dul ba yin te/ gcig gis gcig nus pa 'joms/ ga pur rkyang rgyug ni | gi wang ngam/ bzang drug dang sbyar la chus rta byas la gtang ngo*/ /smyo bar gyur na chang bag tsam cig gtang ngo*/ /'brum pa phyir ma thon pa la/ gi wang*/ gur gum/ gla rtsi gsum chang la sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /des phyi ru hral gyis 'byung*/ lug ngal ba mi mang pa chu la sbyar la gtang*/ des tshad nad thams cad sel bar byed do/ khrag ngan stod du rgyas pa la/ rgya skyegs kyi thang btang*/ rgya skyegs shing gis kyang btub bo/ /chu ser gyi nad la btsod kyi thang btang na phan par 'gyur ro | | pus mo la sogs pa la chu ser byung na/ gze ma zhib par btags la bu ram dang sbyar la gtang*/ des phan no/ /'brum bus gre ba 'gags pa la/ bong bu'i sbangs rdog ma bdun/ ras kyi khud du gtums la chu la sbangs/ de btsir la chu bags kyis bskol ba la/ ka ra'am/ bu ram sbyar la gtang*/ des 'phral la sangs kyis 'gro'o/ /mgo rma la rma kha spra bas brgyangs la bsregs/ des rus skyon thams cad 'gog nas 'ong ngo*/ /thabs gzhan ci yang bya mi dgos so || sprang po nor med kyi bcos thabs bya ba'i gdams ngag go/ //༈ mu zi'i sman mar ni/ mar zho gcig la mu zi srang gnyis btang*/ dang po mar tseg bcad la phyed logs su bsro/

phyed la mu zi bcug la/ mes ran tsam du bskol/ g.yas su bskor zhing dkrugs/ nag mer gyis song ba dang g.yon du bskor/ de nas kha dog brda dmar song ba dang*/ yang g.yas su bskor bas ser cher song ba dang*/ yang g.yon du bskor/ des kha dog dmar por song ba dang/ phog la chu grang mo'i steng du bzhag de nas da ci'i mar blugs la ngad yal ba dang*/ bu ram dang sman gang gtang ba kha tshar gdab bo/ /des byang khog gi rnam skems mchog tu 'gyur ro/ khyad par phul du phyin pa'o/ /bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag dpe las bris pa'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgo bo bcos pa'i man ngag la/ /me bcos zlum bcos mi byed par | | gra bcos gcig pu byed pa ni/ /smyon pa'i lag tu mtshon bskur 'dra/ / gra bcos zlum bcos mi byed par/ /me bcos gcig pu byed pa ni/ /dpa' bo rting non med pa 'dra/ /me bcos gra bcos mi byed par/ /zlum bcos gcig pur byed pa ni/ /lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra/ /zhes gnas skabs shes par bya'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgo dpyad pad+ma dri med ces bya ba 'di la don gsum ste/ dang po chag ma chag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ bcos pa'i thabs dang*/ tha ma rjes gcad pa'o | | de la dang po phyi'i yul bzhi la chag ma chag gi mtshan nyid brtag pa ni/ mig che chung du 'dug la mig sha babs na chung ba'i ngos la skyon yod pa yin/ mig bya shi ba'i mig ltar chung la sleng na rus pa'i rtsa klad pa la zug pa'o/ /mgo chag pa'am rus pa la skyon yod pa/ mig la skrig ga byas na rus pa chag pa'i rtags yin/ rna ba'i ngos nas skrig ga mang la sna'i ngos la med na chag tshabs che ba yin/ mig glo bur du dmar por song na lha 'thems mgo chag tu song ste/ klad pa'i steng du khrag babs pa yin/

mig sprin ser por song nas 'dug na klad pa'i steng na rnag yod/ khrag gi ling tog byung na/ sha rus lha ba gsum dus gcig 'thems pa yin/ mig 'phyi bla 'chol dang smyo 'bog byed na rtsa 'khrugs pa yin/ mig ri bong 'dzis non pa bzhin 'dzums pa dka' na rgya 'khrugs pa yin | spyir rtsa 'khrugs na ni bla 'chol mang*/ rgya 'khrugs ni lkugs par 'gyur ro | kha smra mi shes la bla 'chol byed na rtsa dang rus pa klad pa gsum ka 'khrugs so | | sna gong du rdul chags na lha khrag rgyug pa'i rtags yin/ gdong lci na chu ser lha mig tu shor ba'i rtags yin/ skam byer du 'gro zhing smin ma nyal na steng dung dang lha ba gsum char thems/ rdzi ma tshom bur byer na lha ba 'bros pa'i rtags yin te/ lha ba 'dzin pa'i sman gdab/ klad pa la brtag pa ni/ shed chag na klad pa btsan/ sna zhom na spṛ+i btsan/ sna skam na klad pa la tsha ba shor/ sna khrag don med par 'ong na klad rtsa chad/ dbugs thung la rgod na klad pa'i spris ral | skra 'dab 'dar zhing skyugs na rus pas klad pa non pa yin no/ /lha ba skam byer gyi rtags la/ mchu skam la 'gags na lha ba skam byer gyi rtags yin/ mchu la dreg pa chags pa dang*/ skom dad che ba dang*/ kha kha ba dang*/ lce thung la skam na lha ba skam byer du 'gro/ yang na snying rtsa shor/ mig ser por song na lha ba byer/ lce ser ba dang rtsub pa gnyis/ lha ba byer ba'i rtags yin/ skra 'dab byer na lha rtsa shor/ rtse chung 'phar na yang de bzhin no/ /lha ba gsher byer gyi mtshan nyid ni/ ba spu ldog pa dang*/ snying 'phar ba dang*/ lus la tsha ba skyes pa dang | na teng teng byed pa yang klad pa'i steng na khrag rlangs dang*/ rtsa la skyon yod do/ /mig mi theg na yang rus pas klad pa mnan te chag mig 'og mig dang | 'phred la blta na yang mgo chag mig 'bru tshugs su blta na yang lha ba 'thems pa'i rtags yin/ ltag mig tu blta zhing bzlog na yang chu rgyus kyi rtsa chad

| lha ba 'thems pa'i rtags yin/ klad pa rgya 'khrugs pa ni/ mig 'dzums mi shes/ mig rib rib por res cir mthong*/ res cir mthong ba dang tshig pa za la spro thung ba dang*/ grang shum byed pa dang*/ bya rmyang byed pa dang*/ g.ya' ba dang | sbrid pa mang ba dang*/ yang snyam byed cing skyong ba dang*/ mdor na lag pas mgo la phur/ zug che na mi brjed par na bar byed/ mgo 'thoms la skad gdangs chag pa dang*/ skad mi phyin nas sgeg chos can du smra na lha ba skam byer gyi rtags so/ /skad thogs pa med par sang sang gis smra na gang na yang dogs pa med do/ /'gros gom pa 'dor mi shes na chu rtsa chad pa yin/ rkang lag brkyang bskum mang na mkhal rtsa chad pa y-in/ rtsa'i sgo nas brtag pa ni/ rtsa thung la grims pa dang*/ mkhrang ba dang*/ drag la rgod na skyon yod do/ /rtsa spyir tsha na klad pa'i steng du chu ser thigs te cis kyang skyon yod do/ /rtsa la brtags pa'o/ /chu la brtag pa ni/ chu nyung la yang yang 'ong na mkhal rtsa chad do/ /chu 'ong ba'i tshe sbubs tsha na mchin rtsa chad do/ /chu dmar na lha ba 'thems/ chu ser na lha ba byer | chu 'khrugs na steng 'og gnyis ka chag ku ya ma yal na lha ba byer/ ku ya dengs sam tshig na lha rtsa gnyan po chad pas gso ru mi btub/ ku ya 'thor zhing 'dur ma btub na lha ba byer te chu ser tha ma chod do/ /dri che na lha ba bam/ sngar bas rlangs pa che na lha ba shor/ chu nag la 'khrugs na 'chi/ g.ya' spang gi chu 'dra na klad pa 'khrugs/ chu mdog mi dmar/ mi dkar/ mi ser/ gur gum chad pa'i mdog lta bu'o/ /ku ya bar ma chad na bzang ngo*/ /chu blta ba'i dus tshod ni/ dri dngaro dang kha dog gsum tshan de'i dus su shes par bya'o/ /ku ya spris ma ni rlangs pa chad/ grang bar ma gyur pa la blta'o/ kha sha la brtag pa ni/ rma'i kha sha mkhrang la mtho dman med la bzod pa chung na skyon med do/ kha sha glen pa'i mchu 'dra na skyon yod/ phog ma thag skrangs na skyon med/

phog nas zhag gsum tshun chad la kha sha 'phar na skyon yod/ sha rus 'dres su mi btub na rus pa chag kha sha dpangs mtho ba'am/ yang na zha na yang skyon yod/ sha gdan la brtag pa ni/ sha gdan sngo la sob ba dang*/ skya la sob pa dang*/ nag la sob na skyon yod/ bag zan la mdzub mos mnan pa ltar 'dug na rdo rus ma phrad kyang tshabs chen po yod/ tshor ba chung na skyon yod/ steng 'og tu bems skor byas pas rma kha mkhrang zhing dmar la mtho dman med pa/ tshor ba che la bzod pa chung na skyon med do/ / rus mdog la brtag pa ni/ gas grum dang*/ ser ka la sogs pa mig sngar chags pa ma gtogs par steng gi chag them brtags te mi rgan po'i sen mo dang*/ rus pa gnyis ka ser/ dar ma'i sen mo dang*/ rus mdog gnyis ka dmar/ byis pa'i sen mo dang*/ rus mdog gnyis ka ma nyams na steng chag gri mtshon rnon pos thebs te/ steng nas rus pa shig ro tsam langs te mdog ma nyams na skyon yod/ mde'u'i zur gyis wa lung du song na skyon chung*/ mgo rigs 'ga' zhig la steng na wa yod de/ de yi sha rus mi bye rus mdog mi nyams so/ /rus pa steng 'og gnyis ka chag na sha rus bye zhing rus mdog nyams nas 'ong*/ mnan na rus pa'i gas gang na yod pa der mi bzod pa yin/ mgo chag pa ni rus pa phyi ldeng ldeng yang dkar po shar shar byung na mgo chag rus pa gzhan dmar la dbus su zho lta bur byung na mgo chag nad pa lci zhing dang ga mi bde na mgo chag spyir lha ba 'thems tshabs che na zhag lnga nas na tsha 'byung*/ 'bring bdun/ tha ma dgu nas na tsha 'byung*/ dgu las bcos pa phyis na lha mig tu chu ser 'chor ro/ /rdo'am mtshon rtul pos rus pa'i khrag dbus su bsdus na smug thi le 'ong*/ de la khrag bton pa mchog dmar tsig ge ba'am/ dmar breng breng ba'am/ rtsib ma sos mnan pa ltar song ba dang*/ de rnams lha ba 'thems pa'i rtags yin/ dung du bas khyer ba ltar ser por song ba chu btab pas phyogs bzhir 'gro na lha ba skam byer du song ba'o/

/rus pa mtha' bas dbus dkar ba dang*/ dmar ba dang*/ sngo ba dang*/ ser ba dang*/ nag pa dang/ kha dog mi gcig pa gang byung yang skyon yod/ spyir lha ba 'thems pa zug gzer che/ hong rdol | sgang grum zug gzer chung*/ rtsa la song na zug gzer che/ li phyi la skyer 'brum gtor ba 'dra na rus pa 'grams pa ma tshor te lha ba yang byer/ klad pa'i steng du rnag phebs pa yin/ spyir rus mdog dung 'dra na mgo chag lco ga'i sgo nga 'dra na lha ba 'thems pa yin/ steng dang 'og dang bar gyi lha ba la khrag ngan phebs pa ni/ sen mo sha dang ma bral ba 'dre na skyon med pa yin no/ /yang 'di ltar brtag ldum bu re ral/ bre gu gser thig sbal rgyab/ khab len rnams zhib par btags la chang dang sbyar/ dar gcig zho dron tsam du bskol/ de nas nad pa la blud pas klad pa la skyon yod na sna khrag 'ong*/ rus pa chag na chu ser 'ong | lha ba la skyon yod na sna chu 'ong*/ rtsa la skyon yod na gdong pa skrangs/ sha la skyon yod na na ba'i sar skrangs/ mdor na skyon yod na de'i sha rus dbye'o/ / skra'i sgo nas brtag pa ni skra phag ze ltar 'greng na rus pa dang srubs la skyon yod | skra bar bar nyal na rtsa dang sha la skyon yod/ skra mtshams bye na klad pa'i skyon yin/ skra mtshams zer por song nas 'khrugs na lha ba'i skyon yin/ mdor na sha rus bye ba dang*/ sha mdog mi gcig pa byung na skyon yod pa'i rtags yin no | | smin ma'i sgo nas brtag pa ni/ smin ma zed na rus pa dang*/ srubs la skyon yod/ 'dzings na lha ba dang rtsa la skyon yod/ mig sprin gyi sgo nas brtag pa ni | dkar po la thig le byung na klad pa'i skyon/ dmar po'am ser po byung na rtsa dang pags pa'i skyon/ mig zi zi'am/ har har po'am/ 'degs mi shes na klad pa'i skyon yin/ mig g.yas g.yon rtags gong ltar byung ba de ltar brtag go | lce'i sgo nas brtag pa ni/ lce ser por song na sha la chu ser gram pa yin/

lce 'khums na klad pa'i skyon yin/ lces ro mi tshor na mgo'i srubs bye ba yin/ lce la 'brum bu dmar po byung na rtsa'i skyon yin no/ /'gro 'dug la brtag pa ni/ 'gyel bub mang na klad pa'i skyon yin/ nywa bzhi 'dar na rtsa'i skyon yin no/ /drang por mi tshugs par 'dar na rus pa'i skyon yin/ smra la dga' na mgo srubs bye ba yin/ nyal la dga' na pags pa'i skyon yin no/ /zas kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni | 'grangs dus na ba klad pa'i skyon yin/ bkres dus na ba rus pa'i skyon yin | zos rting 'khyug na rtsa'i skyon yin/ zos rung ma zos rung na na lha ba'i skyon yin/ sna dang so dang gdong pa'i rus pa na ba rus pa'i skyon yin/ mig gi 'bras bu dang klad pa tsha na rtsa'i skyon yin/ gzer ba dang skyugs pa dang*/ 'brum mi chom na mgo srubs bye ba yin/ spyi byin du na ba sha dang pags pa'i skyon yin/ 'thibs na klad pa'i skyon yin/ smra mi shes par ldib pa klad pa'i skyon yin/ gtam la skyed chod 'ong na rus pa'i skyon yin/ zas mi 'dod par grib ma snyegs na rtsa'i skyon yin no/ /byug pa rdzas kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni/ rus pa sngo la gas pa dang*/ ser ka ngo ma shes pa na/ snag tsha'am mtshal rus pa khyab par btab la phyis pas dmar po'am/ nag breng gis byung na skyon yod pa yin no/ / rma'i mtha' de'i skra bzhar la zhag gsum sbang ma'i 'jibs su gzhug sbang ma ma skam pa la ma spos na phyi'i sha mi thul lo/ /me dang nyi ma la mi bsdad/ nyin par gnyid mi log bud med dang mi nyal/ drag shul dang 'o dod mi bya/ dus ma yin par kha zas mi za/ dus kyi kha zas zos pa dang*/ bag re 'chag tu gzhug dugs dang tsha lto la sogs pa yang dang yang du bya'o/ /sha'i rgya nyams pa ni sha lpags thams cad brtse nas/ na bem bem byas nas gnyid bro la mgo mnan pa snyam byed na/ nyi ma la mi bzod la/ zas zos pa'i rjes la na ba la lto stong la bde'o

| | rtsa'i rgya nyams pa ni mgo lus thams cad tsha/ gnyid thum phras byed/ rims kyis btab pa bzhin na/ lus la yang grang 'brum 'ong*/ mgo la reg na mi bzod par tsha/ mgo'i rtsar srog chags 'gro ba snyam byed/ kha skam la dreg pa chags pa/ zas grang mo snying la 'dod pa/ grib ma la snyegs pa'o/ /rus pa'i rgya nyams na mgo mi theg pa snyam byed/ 'khyag 'brum 'ong*/ mig sprin dkar/ skabs su skyugs/ glo bur du langs na mgo 'khor/ yos sam sran ma 'chos na so brtse/ gam du thug cham dang*/ ku co byas na so brtse/ klad pa'i rgya nyams na klad pa pho ba snyam byed/ mgo 'og tu gang bcug pa lci/ shes pa mi gsal/ dang ga mi bde/ brjed ngas/ yan lag 'dar/ bla 'chol mang po 'ong*/ yang byer ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ nang gi spris byer ba zhes bya ste/ dar ma dang gnyis ma 'byor ba'o/ /bar lha ba byer ba ni sngo nag sob sob 'ong ba'o/ /phyi'i rus pa byer ba ni dung la ham pa chags pa'o/ /rtsa tsha byer ba ni lus tsha la skom dad che ba'o | | grang byer ni dang po skya bo byil byil por 'ong*/ phyi'i skyi byer ba ni glog pa skya bun du byas nas 'tsho ru mi 'dod pa'o/ /chag pa dang*/ rtsa lam dang*/ rgya srubs rnams nor nyen yod pas gzabs la brtags te/ chag na khab mgo btsugs la bton/ rus pa la skad 'ong ngo*/ /rtsa lam dang rgya srubs 'jam pa la khab khral khral 'ong ngo*/ /mgo la mda' phog nas klad pa la thal na skam pas dbyung du mi rung*/ zlum por bskor la snyi ba ldeg ldeg tu rus pa brdar la/ mde'u rang 'gyel du btang ngo*/ /mde'u ldeb kyis phog na mde'u'i sna ru gron bcug ste dra/ 'og grum na mthongs brtol/ rus pa thag chod par brdar/ rtsa rnams me btsas bsrung*/ rgya srubs la babs na phyi ru me btsas sbrel la bsrung*/ nang du rgya srubs kyi sna bcad do/ /de rnams ni rma'i 'khos bcad pa dang*/ chag ma chag gi mtshan nyid bstan zin to//

//de nas gnyis pa bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa ni/ steng chag pa dang*/ dras rdzogs pa rnams ni drod dang lums kyis bcos so/ /sha mi dra/ rus pa la sgo brud mi bya/ zhag dgu tshun chad nya ra bsgrims/ sha gsar dang chang gsar pas bcos

| log na phug nas bcos so/ /steng 'og gnyis ka chag nas sha dra bar shes na rus skyon bsal thabs ni/ spyi gtsug sha ni bzhag skor 'dra ste bskor du mi rung*/ mtshog ma'i sha ni gzhu'i bshul sha 'dra ste mi bskor/ dbus su dra/ ltag pa'i sha ni nya gdang gshibs pa 'dra ste gshags la dra/ 'phred la chod du mi rung | ltag pa'i rtsa nag po dang*/ rtse'u'i mgo g.yas g.yon dang*/ gzer rtsa dang | 'phar rtsa dang*/ gnyan pa rnams bskor mi rung*/ de rnams su sho re dang*/ sum shor dang*/ bzhi shor dang*/ bong mchu dang*/ zla tshes ltag sprod dang*/ gang ltar rigs par 'os par dra/ gtsag rnon por ma btab/ 'dar ma langs par dras la pags pa dang sha gdan gnyis dus gcig la bsal/ gru bzhi dang gru gsum dang zlum por mi dra/ bal ye chu ru bcug pas khrag phyis la blta/ gzer rtsa 'khyam po 'ong srid pas dmar po'i thig le 'dug na gzabs la lte ba bzhin du bzhag dar ya kan rtsa de phyi ru brdar/ phyi ma rnams bskor ro/ /de yang dang po 'khor gyis mnan te/ de'i yon tan rtsa dang sha sbrid pas nad pa bzod pa che la sha dang rtsa'i khrag mi 'chor ro/ /de nas dras pa'i steng la sman pas ltem rtse bcug sha rus bye ma bye'i mtshams su nyul zhing bltas la sha rus bye ma bye'i mtshams tshun chad dra/ ltem rtse phyid kyis song na yang dra ste/ gas chag thams cad dras 'og tu tshud par bya/ khrag byung na bal ye chu ru bcug pas gdab/ 'khor drag tu mnan/ des ma chod na spra ba hrag hrog bsregs pas rma kha brdzangs/ de nas skyung bus mtha' ma 'bos bzhin du brdar la thag bcad/ khrag ngan dang chu ser gdon/ khrag gson shi dbye/ dbus su lha ba'i lhag ma mi bzhag par dal bus sbyangs/ klad pa'i tshas su rus pa sbrang 'dab tu byas la/ dbus sen mos 'grum | byi tshe mig khyim bya'i mig mang du phug la bcos/ khrag ngan pa ni gnag pa dang*/ ser ba dang*/ bya pha wang rgyab ngan pas thon chad gdon/

gas kyi sna ru bye tshe mi dbug yang na mang du phug pas klad pa spos nas mi 'tshang*/ klad pa la 'phar non mi dgos pa'o/ /lha ba'i khrag dmar la dwangs shing sbrang char bzhin du kun nas snyoms par 'bab na rang bzhin gyi lha khrag yin no/ /rtsa snad pa dang lha ba 'thems pa zhag bdun nam dgu 'das na lha ba byer nas 'gro/ de nas btsan khrag myur du gdon/ sbang ma phabs dang bcas rma kha khyab par g.yogs/ nangs par rma kha phye tsam na khrag ro ra shig lug shig tsam cal le 'dug na rma ldog go /mdor na rma ni rlan dang drod kyis bcos/ de nas gzod rdzogs nas rus thag chod/ lha ba gson pa dang*/ phrad pa dang*/ rma rtsi ka ra gur gum mchal dang gsum rta sbyar la gtang*/ skabs su ka ra gcig pu gtang*/ lha ba la sha gzer ma 'debs kyi bar du rma'i nang du glum dang mar dkar sbyar la byugaglum dang phabs sbyar bas mtha' ma byug man ngag nges pa'i zin du rus pa'i bzo ma zin gyi bar la sbang ma mi gtang*/ rus bzo zin nas khrag mkhṛs can nam | nam sla drod dus su sbang ma drags na lha ba 'byer/ mar tshil rnams gnyis dpyad la gtang*/ de'i yon tan gyi lha ba mi 'byer la/ rma kha 'khyags rum bzhin du sdud/ dbyar ston dro ba'i dus su grang mo gtang*/ dgun dpyid grang ba'i dus su drod la dbab/ lcibs kyi steng du pags bu bye'u lces dgab/ de nas ras mas g.yogs la ras 'jag gis dkri/ lha ba'i sha gzer 'thems nas mar dkar dang*/ zho chu btsir ba gang 'phrod gtang*/ khye'us 'thungs pa'i nu zhos rma bkru/ byi tshe mig dang*/ chag so na yar sha ngan 'dzer pa'i thabs su skye la | klad pa mtho la bsdeb mi nus la/ rtsa dang phyi yul tsha bar 'dug na klad pa tsha sbaus zhes kyang bya ste/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ ka ra gdab/ yang na ga pur/ gur gum/ ka ra sbyar la byug go /chu'i rde'u 'tsham pas steng nas mnan/ de'i steng du re ba mar gyis byugs pas mnan/ des kyang ma non te sha'u zam thogs na

| klad pa grang sbos yin te/ sha'u gzha' ba yin pas dra/ phying pa mkhregs po mar du btsos pa'i tshan de gsum brtsegs kyis kha sha la ma reg par glan/ srin bal gyi skud pas thod thabs su bcing*/ des kyang ma zhig na klad 'dzer de ra gan gyi rdel pas bsur/ zhag 'ga' sha chang bcad la nyams smad/ klad pa dang | lha ba dang*/ sha'i sha'u gsum zam thogs nas/ dom mkhris ka ra sbyar la nang ma rkang chag gtang ngo*/ /bzo byas nas nang ma gnyis gsum gyi nangs par la | lha ba smug la dwangs shing*/ rnag ska la rma kha mtho la mkhrang zhing snyoms pa dang | nad pa seng zhing gnyid chung la/ dang ga bde na bzhed do/ /spyir khrag mkhris can la dgun yang bsil gyis bcos/ rgan pa la rma chas dbyar yang dro bar bya/ dbyar gyi rlan zho btsir bas bya/ sngo bsil par pa ta dang*/ sha mo dang lcam pa sbyar la kha zhun bya/ dgun mar tshil dang sbang ma dang*/ spod la sogs pa cha bsnyams/ mi rgan po khrag mkhris shas che ba yang yod/ de la kha zas bsil drod cha bsnyams par byas la gtang*/ zhag bcu drug gam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig nas chang khyor tshad tsam la nyams tshad/ dar ma grang rlung shas che ba yang yod pas kha zas dang rma chas drod du bya/ dpyid zho dang sbang mas bya/ de dag ni sha'u bskyed pa'i thabs so/ kha zhun drod che la mthug na sha'u phyir la 'ju/ dbyar grang chas su gtang*/ rma dkris yang cha snyoms par bya/ sman pas rnag 'phye ba la brtson pas kyang sha'u skyed par 'gyur ro/ /rma rab la zhag bcu dgu/ 'bring la dgu/ tha ma la zhag lnga la bsil bsten/ de man chad cha mnyam pa tha ma drod la btsal bas te/ de yang drod bsil 'theng 'gros su btang ste/ rlung mkhris che chung la sogs pa rig pa'i mdas bsnun/ bsil drod gang gtang yang khyor tshad sum yar gtang*/ rma'i lci bas mdor bsdu na dgun zla gsum dang*/ dpyid zla gsum drod kyis bcos/ dbyar zla gsum snyoms kyang drod kyis bcos/ ston zla gsum tshad pa'i dus yin pas bag tsam bsil gyis bcos so/

/spyir sbang ma chang 'gag pa dang*/ pag pu drod ma dang*/ skyi dkar bzang pos g.yogs/ sha'u brtag pa ni/ rus 'dzer thams cad rdzogs nas rma kha khod bsnyams la mtha' ma nas rman pa chags nas/ rnag sla na dar ya kan dang mkhris chen gdab/ yang na ngan mkhris sna tshogs snyoms par gdab/ rus 'dzer rdzogs nas shas khengs nas sha snyoms tho re byung na bshul tshig dang*/ skom rtsi gtang*/ kha zhun mi gtang*/ drag shul mi bya/ kha zas bcud can gtang ngo*/ /lcags g.ya' chags pa la gnyis yod de/ shan phyed nas chags na bzang*/ 'chi khar yang chags pa yod/ rus pa lha ba chags su mi btub na sings po gsar 'jam gtang*/ des tsha ba skyed par bzo na 'phro bcad/ tsha ba mi skye na sha chang rgyun du gtang*/ mi mgo skam la smin phrag dog pa rnams rus pa srab pas zhag bdun nam/ dgu'am/ bcu gcig na chag sos/ mi mgo sha che ba la smin phrag yangs pa rnams rus pa yang mthug pas/ lha ba yang mod la 'chag myur du ma chags na mi thub bo/ /dang la sha bcud la gtang*/ tsha ba che na rnga bran gyi sha gtang*/ rlung che na yib ma dang*/ chang bzang po gtang ngo*/ /spyir bzo ma byas par sha chang mi gtang*/ bzo byas nas lug sha gsar pa btang*/ rgan pa bcud kyis gsos te sha chang gtang*/ dar ma me'i khams la zas khre'ur gtang*/ byis pa chu'i khams la zas drod la brten | nad pa spyod lam gzabs/ tsha grang rtsa chu la brtags la bcos so/ / gzhug rma skam thag chod nas sha chang sprug go/spyir mgo rma'i dug sha rul sungs dang | nya/ sgo nga*/ mar rnying*/ zho/ bra zan/ sgog skya/ g.yer ma/ chang skyur spangs/ sha gsar chang gsar gtang ngo*/ /phog sa ngan pa ni/ smin mtshams mdzod spur phog na gnyan/ de bcos nyes na 'chi bas sna rtsa gtar/ an tong rus bsreg lug gi mchin pa gtang ngo*/ /ltag pa drang po na yar sor bzhi na chu rgyus thams cad kyi mgo yin pas gnyan te/ mig 'bras dang*/ mig rus ngan pas de la spyi gtsug tu me btsa' bya/

rtse chung gtar ro/ /spyi bo'i gtsug ni klad pa'i bya tshang zhes bya ste/ rus pa chag na mi 'tsho/ rtsa kha mi 'dra ba gnyis byung na glags yod/ kos ko'i kung kung po ru phog na gnyan pas kha ldan du mi gzhug go /mgo chags pa bcos pa'i thabs ni/ sha rus bye ba'i mtshams tshun chad sha dras la rus pa brdar/ lha ba rgyab nas brdar/ dbus dal bus sbyang*/ by-i tshe mig mang du phug pas klad pa'i steng nas chu ser gdon/ bud med sha rtsi dkar la rigs bzang ba/ na so gzhon pa/ spyod lam dal ba/ khye'u byung ba'i nu zho blugs la/ nad pa'i kha sna rnams la klad pas 'debs su gzhug go /sgo grum bcos pa'i thabs la sha'i kha dras kham che ru byas la/ rus pa bag tsam gtang*/ klad pa'i steng du rus 'dzer 'dug na mi ldog par dbyung du mi rung*/ rus 'dzer btsan 'then bya ru mi rung*/ rang byung du bzhag zhag lnga lon pa'i nangs par ga pur dang*/ rgya tshwa/ ka ra gdab/ zhag bdun lon nas 'gul 'gul 'byung*/ rus 'dzer phyung ba'i shul gyi sha dang*/ klad pa sngo'am/ nag na rgya tshwa dang*/ ru rtas klad pa'i rul bcad/ ga pur/ cu gang*/ ka ra gsum gyis klad pa'i tsha ba gzhil | gur gum dang dom mkhris kyis klad pa'i dbugs 'don/ 'om bu'i bar shun gyis klad pa'i dar gso/ klad pa mtho la mi 'debs na mnan pa gong ltar bya'o/ /hong rul bcos pa'i thabs ni/ rus pa gtibs pa yin te/ sha dras la rus pa snga sngo brdar/ rus 'dzer rang byung du bzhag rus pa gtibs pa'i steng 'og na sha'u skye ba yang yod/ rus 'dzer btsan 'don byas na rtsa chad pa yang yod/ klad pa nar gyis byung nas shi ba yod pas gzab par bya'o/ /gzhan gong dang mthun/ klad pa dma' na zas bstod/ mtho na zas smad/ klad pa'i spri btsan nas spri dang klad pa'i bar na rnag zhugs na mdog ser por 'ong*/ rnag gi me tog dkar po byung na 'jab rtses spri bzung la/ gtsag pu'i so yar bstan la brtol lo/

/lha 'thems bcos pa'i thabs la/ zhag lnga'am drug tshun chad rma che chung dang sbyar la sha dra/ rus pa brdar/ sum gnyis yar blang*/ lha ba 'thems pa yun ring nas sa bcad pa'i shul 'dra na mgo la gtugs/ mgo chag na byi tshe mig mang du dbug mthongs brtol la bcos/ de yang steng blangs nas 'og srab mor brdar tsam na rgya bar smug lam mi 'dug na byi tshe mig dbug mi dgos/ kha dog nag po'am/ ser po 'dug na dbug de nas rnag chu gdon te/ chu ser nag la mang ba'am/ gcod sdom byed pa rnams ni thon tshad kyis 'don to/ /lha ba'i gson khrag ni thams cad la snyoms par 'dug pa dang*/ dmar la dwangs pa dang*/ zhag sro ma tsam tsig tsig 'dug na yin/ gzer rtsa'i khrag ni dmar la mig rdol ba ltar 'ong*/ dmar la 'khyil ba dang*/ nag la rlangs pa can du 'ong*/ tsid tsid pa ni gcod sdom can yin/ de yang skam pa'i phyogs su brdar/ rma'i kha sha zha ba'i ngos su khrag gson po dang sprad/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ lha ba skam na khong du chang btang*/ rma kha rlon na lums su gzhug tshil lam pags pas gtums | zhag dgu lon nas lha ba khyer zhes bya ste/ btsan khrag gis lha ba phyir 'phul nas mi sos so/ /brdar tsam na lha mig nas rnag sib sib 'dug na mi sos so/ /lha mig gi chu ser rnag tu song na mi sos so/ /lha mig nas rnag til 'bru tsam 'byung ba mi sos so/ /lha mig sngo la brdar tsam na skam phrul phrul 'dug na skam byer yin pas 'chi/ rma kha skam na 'chi/ rtsa shed chung la myur na 'chi | dbang po yul log par 'dzin cing bla 'chol smra na 'chi/ skyugs pa dang*/ smyo ba dang*/ /bla ba dang*/ 'bogs na 'chi/ des na lha ba 'thems pa myur du bcos dgos so/ /'on kyang skam byer la tshigs pa gsum pa bsreg snying zho sha'i thang btang ngo*/ gsher byer la phur mo'i lo ma'i thal ba/ ba bla/ ldong ros/ myang rtsi spras kyis lha ba skems/ sha gsar tsho khu gtang ngo*/ /klad pa gso ba'i thabs la/

rus pa'i gam gtib pas rus 'dzer gyis spri btsan nas bar du rnag zhugs pa yod/ rus 'dzer phyung ba'i rjes la spri sngon po 'byung ba yang yod de/ de la ga pur/ gur gum/ 'dam bu sbyar la gdab/ spri dang klad pa'i bar gyi rnag brtol | de nas nag po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ mang pos 'khrugs na sha'u dmar po sreg ge 'dug na nyen med spri ral na dar ya kan dang bcad 'byor/ dom mkhris | 'om bu'i bar shun gyi 'dam rnams gtang*/ klad pa 'dzag na mu tig dang dom mkhris/ khye'us 'thungs pa'i nu zho dang sbyar la/ 'thems su stag sha bskus la gtang*/ des chad do/ /klad pa tsha sbos ni/ rtse chung dang phyi yul tsha/ zug gzer che la dang ga mi bde/ rma che la rnag mang*/ de la nya ra 'bad/ rus pa nyams bskyung ngo*/ /grang sbos ni phyi yul la sogs pa grang ba'o/ /de ni grang rlung skyes pa las 'byung ngo*/ /sha'u rmen pa'i thabs su prog prog pos skyes na mnan pas kyang ma non na 'khar ba'i thur mas bsreg rtse mo skya khyi le byas nas/ chu 'jigs pa 'ong ste/ mnan pas ma non na ra gan nam/ lcang mas bsreg bsregs pas de rnams nyol nyol por 'gro ste/ 'og nas sha'u gsha' ma skye'o/ / dpyad bcos bya ru mi rung*/ klad pa gtib na glum gyi nye'u gtang*/ sha gsar chang gsar gtang*/ rtsa chod pa la gang du me btsa' gdab/ khrag ma chod na spra bas bsregs pas chod/ spyi gtsug nas mtshog ma'i ngos su mtshon gang bcal ba na rtsa gcig yod de/ de chod na spyi gtsug nas mtshog ma'i bar thams cad tsha lam lam 'ong bas/ de la spyi gtsug tu spra ba gsum bzhag spru ba'i rtsa ba'am/ gro ga'i rtsa ba'am/ za 'og gi gzhob kyi thal bas bcad/ phyi 'thems kyis mnan | rtsa'i gong 'og du me btsa' gdab/ rna ba'i mdun rgyab kyi rtsa sgor snad na rtse chung gdab/ zhu mkhan dang 'om bu'i dugs kyis rtsa'i tsha ba 'don/ rma'i tho phyi gzer zhing rtsa 'phar na gtar ga byas pas phan no/

/yang na bsregs na phan no || lha ba'i rtsa'i 'od dang*/ ser kha'i 'od nor nyen yod de/ lha rtsa'i 'od ni smug ser kha'i 'od ni gnag par 'ong*/ rtsa chod na gser gyis bsros la dom mkhris rtsa khar gdab/ gzer rtsa chod nas khrag chu mig lta bur byung na zhag gnyis sam gsum na lha ba sngo sob sob tu song nas 'chi'o/ /rgya rtsa zhes bya ba mtshog ma nas ltag khung thug pa rtsa sbom po cig yod/ rna ba'i mdun rgyab gnyis na dpag bsam gyi ljon shing bzhi yod/ spyi bo nas yar lag pa'i sor mo bkram pa bzhin yod | dpral ba'i zur gnyis na yar rtsa 'greng bu gnyis yod de/ de chad na bcos thabs med de 'chi/ btsan pa sman gyis gso'o/ /rma thog tu rdo phog pa dang | mthongs ka mkhrang ba'am/ re bzhi'am/ ka gdung la brdabs nas klad pa'i mtsho 'khrugs te gdong pa lci la mig ri bong rdzis non pa 'dra la/ skyugs shing col 'khrul mang na rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon gtar/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu gsang dbye | skra bregs la spod sna tshogs dang*/ spang spos dang mar dang sbyar la mgo khyab par byugs/ gra phying la 'bol log bzhin byas la/ khram shar byas te skyur la phab la glan/ zhag bdun dar dang men tris rgya chings bya/ de'i steng du blang 'breng dang sog mig gis rgya chings bya/ sgo bzhir phur bus bsnol la brdegs/ zhag bdun mi bkrol bar bzhag rgya srubs su mar dang tshil bu bzhu bas zhun bya

| gla sgang gi phye ma gdab/ spos kyi phye ma dang mar dang tshil bu sbyar la byugs/ re bal gyi 'dab ma khye'u nu zho 'thungs pa'i chus drod phab la/ de'i steng du phying bu drod phab la dgab/ de nas pags bu drod phab la dgab/ de nas 'jag gis dkri/ sha 'thems dang rus 'thems dang lung 'bur rnams zla ba gcig gis sangs pa srid/ na tsha chung na thub pa yin/ zug gzer che na gas sna dang rtsa'i yar sna mar snar me btsa' bya/ gtsag kha bstan du mi rung*/ pags pa ma ral ba la yon tan gsum yod de/ sha'i dbugs mi 'chor ba'i yon tan dang*/ khrag ma shor bas rus pa la khrag mi 'chor ba'i yon tan dang*/ rus pa dang pags pa'i dbugs ma shor bas sha dang khrag 'tsho/ khrag gis rus pa 'tsho/ drod kyis bcos pas khrag dang chu ser skam ste rang skam du gar song cha med par 'gro'o | | zhag gsum bzhi na kha zas yen la gtad/ de nas sha chang sbrugs ma gtang | tsha ba che na bsil drod khre'ur gtang*/ lto tshas na rnag tu 'gro nyen che/ mer mer por 'ong ste brtol du mi rung ngo*// //༈ byis pa'i mgo chag pa bcos pa ni/ byis pa nu zho 'thung pa man chad brdar du mi rung*/ spyir yang byis pa la dra ba dang brud pa 'tsham par bya/ rus pa so rtsigs su song na 'jam bcos bya/ zhom pa dang*/ gas pa dang*/ lha ba 'thems na sho re byas la rus pa brdar/ klad 'thems shes par byas la/ de nas drod kyis bcos/ dar dmar po dang pags bus dkri/ drod kyis bcos/ da ni rma lhog pa'i rtags bstan te/ g.yal mang ba dang*/ ltag mig blta ba dang*/ skabs su skyigs bu 'byung zhing yed yed po byas pa dang*/ bya rmyang byed snying 'dod pa dang*/ byad ser ba dang*/ mig sprin ser na klad pa'i steng na rnag yod/ tsag tsag byed na lha ba 'bros/ grang sib sib dang bring bring byed na lha ba 'bros/ 'dar ba dang lus grang sib sib 'dug na yang lha ba 'bros/ kha kha la skom dad che na yang ldog

zug gzer che la mchu dmar na yang ldog zas yi gar mi 'ong na ldog 'dod chags spyad na ldog zhag bcu gsum lon nas ldog pa nyung ste/ ji srid log kyang gso ru rung ngo*/ /mtheb skor byas pas mi bzod pa'i sa na skyon yod/ rnag rtsa dmar ba dang*/ ser ba dang*/ sngo ba dang*/ sla ba dang*/ dri mi zhim pa dang*/ gshin dri chags na ngan/ rnag dkar la 'jam na bzang*/ nad pa na tsha chung na bzang*/ ro rgyab gzer ba dang*/ bshul sha na ba dang*/ tshigs gzhi na ba dang*/ pho kha 'khor ba dang*/ mkhris pa skyugs na 'chi/ log na bcos pa'i thabs la/ skyon gang byung ba'i ngos su sha dra/ rus pa yang brdar/ rtsa mig gi chu ser yang gdon/ rnag chu gang nas 'ong ba'i ngos nas rnag btsags/ lha mig stong pa spa bcad pa 'dra na de'i lha ba ded la khong nas chang dang sha gsar gyis bud | slo dang sbang ma bsres pa'i lums bya/ drod tshil dang pags pas gtums/ rnag khur ma chad pa 'dra na ni sa cig na med par col le ba ste phal cher 'chi/ lha mig sngo sib sib song na yang 'chi/ lha mig nas rnag til 'bru tsam sngo tsig tsig byung na 'chi/ sha'u mgo che zhag gcig gnyis na skye na tsha ba'i bad ces bya ste brdar dgos so/ /klad pa'i rgya thog tu rnag lhung ba ni chag ste srubs zhig pa dang | rus pa chags pa ma tshor ba las 'byung ste/ nad pa khong lci la dang ga mi bde | grang shum dang stong skyugs byed/ rkang lag bshal nas mig ser na klad pa'i rgya thog tu rnag lhung ba yin pas rgya bskyed la sha dra/ rus pa brdar/ 'og gi gdan la thug tsam na gzabs la srab mor brdar/ de nas rnag gi 'od blta ba ste | lu gu nyal ba ltar skya khyil le 'dug na rnag gi 'od yin/ de'i thog tu brtol bas chog rma rtsi gong dang 'dra/ yang g.yas lta bu la phog pa na g.yon chag pa yang 'ong ste/ de'i thad kar rtag tu na ru 'ong*/ 'bur gyis byung na chag pa yin pas dras la brdar/ thang dang byi tshe mig tshod dang sbyar ro/

/klad pa tsha sbos chen po ni nyen che ste/ rtse'u chung la khrag lcogs tshad dbyung ngo*/ /de la sman dang kha zas drod can sbyar na 'chi/ lha ba skam bros la sman dang kha zas bsil du btang na 'chi/ bcos kyang skyed med pa'i nad pa spang*/ kha sha zha ba'i bcos thabs la spod sna tshogs dang*/ gla sgang dang*/ spang spos mar dang zho sbyar la lums dang dugs bya/ gting skyon che bas 'phral du 'chi bar bshad do/ /rma kha skam la lha ba byer ba rnag chu gting du song ba'i rtags yin/ yang na skam byer du 'gro ba yin te phal cher 'chi'o/ /rtsa byer la gang du byung bar gtar sreg dang bsil drod kyi dugs sna tshogs bya'o/ /rngul 'don ni/ da ni rtsa zil gyis mnan pa'i thabs la/ spyi bo'i gnam rten dang*/ dpral ba'i 'dzum rten dang*/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon na re re/ ltag pa'i chu mgo gnyis/ de rnams byer ram so mig ma tshor ba'am/ bcos ma legs na gnam rten shor na a wa dhū tī zhes bya ste/ srog rtsa dang rgyu ma la 'bab bo/ /rna ltag gi rtsa gnyis shor nas bshul sha la 'bab pas bshul sha rengs pas ltag pa dgye bor 'gro/ 'dzum rten shor na glo ba la 'bab | rna ba'i mdun ngos kyi rtsa gnyis shor na pho mchin la 'bab/ ltag pa'i chu mgo'i rtsa gnyis shor na rkang pa la 'bab pas gzabs la bcos/ ma gzabs pa rnams la rtsa gnyen po rnams klu drag po dang 'dra'o/ /da ni sha'i rtsa zil gyis mnan te/ sha rtsa chen po la mtshon phog pa'am/ sha rus pas chod nas khrag ma chod na phying pa srab mkhregs kyis phying them bya/ de'i steng du dar 'jag gis rgya chings bya/ rtsa 'ol kha bsgyur/ phyis me btsas bsrung ngo*/ /rus pa'i rtsa zil gyis mnan pa ni/ khrag gson gshin sprod/ klad pa zil gyis mnan pa ni/ rna ba'i phyi nang na dpag bsam gyi yal ga bzhi yod pas de la rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon gtar bas thur du 'bros mi nus so/ /klad pa dang rus pa'i bar gyi chu ser thon nas rtsa yang 'bros mi nus so/

/sman dang zas kyis khong nas bus pas rnag dang chu ser gyen la rgyug cing rma gsher bar 'gyur/ zas kyi bye brag gis tsha grang cha mnyam/ gzer rtsa zil gyis mnan pa ni rtsa'i mtha' ma bskor te dbus lte bar bzhag btsan na gser gyi tel pas bsreg khong nas zas dang sman gyis bud do/ /man ngag 'di ni byams pa dang snying rje sngon du song bas bcos/ de lta ma yin pa'i sman pa ni gshin rje'i lag pa na mtshon thogs pa dang 'dra ste/ mi na ba na bar byed/ na ba 'chi bar byed pas sman mkhan byang chub sems dpa' snying rje dang ldan pas bya'o/ /man ngag 'di ni me tog gi nang nas sbrang rtsi dang 'dra'o/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las mgo dpyad pad+ma dri med ces bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di las 'phros pa'i mgo dpyad la ming 'dogs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang*/ ngo bo 'di las med gsungs so/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag nas phyung ba'i sman sbyor dang*/ rgyud sde zab mo rnams nas bshad pa'i sngags dang*/ rdzas kyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan rjes su gzung ba'i thabs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung las thos shing phyag len du mdzad pa rnams gdul bya man ngag gis dben pa rnams kyi don du phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas/ gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces mtshan du gsol ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //'dis sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/ // rje btsun grags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma dpo lnga pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 532PAGE 533
